news.Title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Just Sold Over 50% of Berkshire Hathaway's Stake in Nucor and Piled Into an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock That Billionaire Investor Bill Ackman Just Exited
news.Content:
Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE: BRKA) (NYSE: BRKB) recently filed its latest Form 13F with the Securities and Exchange Commission, detailing what its equity holdings were at the end of the second quarter.

Investors are always curious about what Berkshire has been buying and selling because its former chief, Warren Buffett, is widely considered one of the greatest investors of all time.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Now that he has stepped down as CEO, however, the market is even more focused on his handpicked successor, Greg Abel, who has been CEO of Berkshire since the start of the year and has already begun making some big changes at the company.

In Q2, Abel sold over 50% of Berkshire's stake in Nucor (NYSE: NUE) and piled into another artificial intelligence (AI) stock -- one that billionaire investor Bill Ackman just exited.

Nucor: In and out

One of Buffett's core investing philosophies is that Berkshire should buy stocks it can hold forever. But it's a high threshold to meet that bar, and often, companies don't.

That appears to be the case for Nucor, the largest U.S. steelmaker. Berkshire purchased around 5.75 million shares of it at the beginning of 2025 and has since sold more than two-thirds of that initial investment over the past two quarters, including over half of its position in Q2.

The stock has performed well, including a nearly 62% gain so far in 2026 and a roughly 82% gain over the past 12 months. Nucor has been swept into the AI trade due to increasing demand for steel from the companies that are building data centers.

In Q2, Nucor's earnings before income taxes and noncontrolling interests surged by about 48% from the prior quarter, driven by strong growth across its operations. The company's largest division, steel mills, saw strong demand and higher prices.

Given that, it's hard to say exactly why Abel and the investment team at Berkshire decided to cut the conglomerate's stake in Nucor. It's obviously not a core position, so Abel and his team are likely taking gains, or perhaps they think that its earnings growth is bound to slow down.

Alphabet: An interesting time to be moving into the stock

Even before the deadline for filing 13F forms arrived, we already knew Berkshire had significantly increased its position in Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG)(NASDAQ: GOOGL) in Q2, given the $10 billion private placement announced at the start of June. But it looks like Berkshire also purchased an additional $7 billion of shares in the open market.

Story Continues

Alphabet is now the third-largest position in Berkshire's portfolio, sitting only behind Apple and American Express .

Earlier this year, Buffett said during a CNBC interview that he had been the one to initiate the conglomerate's initial Alphabet position in 2025. But it has been under Abel's watch that it grew into a top-three position in Berkshire's portfolio. (However, Buffett, who remains the executive chairman of Berkshire's board of directors, could still be behind the move.)

Either way, it's an interesting time to be buying Alphabet, given that the stock hit an all-time high in May of this year and is up nearly 150% over the past five years.

Some large hedge fund managers have begun to take their gains on Alphabet, notably Bill Ackman, whose fund Pershing Square Capital Management exited its position in the tech giant over the past two quarters.

On May 16, after selling most of Pershing Square's Alphabet position in the first quarter of the year, Ackman tweeted on X:

To be clear, our sale of $GOOG was not a bet against the company. We are very bullish long term on Alphabet. But at current valuations and in light of our finite capital base, we used $GOOG as a source of funds for $MSFT.

An investment in Alphabet is a clear bet on AI at this point, and the company is planning to spend potentially north of $200 billion on AI capital expenditures this year alone. Still, the company does have many other strong tech businesses, including YouTube, Waymo, cloud, search and advertising, and a custom chip business.

It's possible that Buffett and Abel see Alphabet as a forever stock.

Buffett has long believed in buying wonderful companies at fair prices, so while Alphabet may not have as much upside over, say, the next year, which might make it unattractive to more near-term-minded hedge funds, the Berkshire team likely still believes they are getting in at a good price over the long term.

news.Title: Warren Buffett's and Greg Abel's $175 Billion Warning Echoes Loudly Through Wall Street
news.Content:
Two events that always seem to captivate investors' attention are Berkshire Hathaway 's (NYSE: BRKA)(NYSE: BRKB) operating results and its quarterly Form 13F filing. Given the phenomenal investing track record of Berkshire's now-retired CEO, Warren Buffett , and his protégé, Greg Abel, it pays to know which stocks are intriguing Berkshire's bosses .

But over much of the last four years, Buffett's and Abel's investing activity hasn't meshed with the long-term ethos they've preached. Even though Berkshire's new CEO, Abel, was a net buyer of stocks in the June-ended quarter, to the tune of $19.8 billion, this dynamic duo has been a net seller of equities since October 2022.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

For those willing to dig beneath the headlines, it's impossible to miss Warren Buffett's and Greg Abel's warning to Wall Street.

Buffett and Abel have been net sellers of stocks in 14 of the last 15 quarters

During the second quarter, Abel spent about $17 billion purchasing shares of Alphabet . This accounted for the lion's share of Berkshire's buying activity, making its net purchasing for the quarter somewhat deceptive.

Over the last 15 quarters, Buffett and Abel have been net sellers in 14 of them:

Q4 2022 : $14.64 billion in net-equity sales

Q1 2023 : $10.41 billion

Q2 2023 : $7.981 billion

Q3 2023 : $5.253 billion

Q4 2023 : $0.525 billion

Q1 2024 : $17.281 billion

Q2 2024 : $75.536 billion

Q3 2024 : $34.592 billion

Q4 2024 : $6.713 billion

Q1 2025 : $1.494 billion

Q2 2025 : $3.006 billion

Q3 2025 : $6.099 billion

Q4 2025 : $3.164 billion

Q1 2026 : $8.149 billion

Q2 2026 : $19.774 billion in net-equity purchases

Collectively, Berkshire's bosses have sold a net of $175 billion in stock since Oct. 1, 2022, and these actions send an undeniable warning to investors.

Finding a good deal has been challenging amid a historically pricey stock market

While Abel may feel more comfortable buying tech stocks than his predecessor, one undeniable trait shared by Buffett and Abel is their unwavering desire to get a good deal. Though Buffett bent or broke several of his unwritten investing rules as Berkshire Hathaway's CEO, he never chased a stock that he didn't feel was attractively valued.

The problem with today's stock market is that finding a good deal is challenging.

In a 2001 interview with Fortune magazine, Warren Buffett referred to the price-to-GDP ratio (now known as the Buffett indicator) as "probably the best single measure of where valuations stand at any given moment." When backtested to December 1970, this measure, which divides the market value of all U.S. stocks by U.S. gross domestic product (GDP), has averaged 88%. On Aug. 12, the Buffett indicator hit an all-time high of 240.32%!

Story Continues

Buffett's and Abel's $175 billion in net selling since October 2022 is an actions-speak-louder-than-words warning that stock market valuations aren't sustainable. The last time the S&P 500 's (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) Shiller Price-to-Earnings Ratio was this high was in the lead-up to the bursting of the dot-com bubble.

Even though both of Berkshire's bosses rightly remain long-term optimists -- and there's no reason not to be, given the multidecade performance of the S&P 500 -- their $175 billion warning rightly echoes through Wall Street.

news.Title: D-Wave Quantum vs. Microsoft: Which Is the Better Quantum Computing Stock to Own for the Next 5 Years?
news.Content:
Quantum computing has significant potential to transform a host of technologies, including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, materials science, and drug discovery. But it's still in a relatively early stage of development, which makes it difficult to guess now which quantum computing stocks might be winners over the long term.

Two companies on many investors' quantum computing radar are pure-play D-Wave Quantum (NASDAQ: QBTS) and tech giant Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT). Given where the quantum computing market is right now, and considering Microsoft's financial advantages, Microsoft stock is the no-brainer winner.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What's happening with D-Wave right now?

I get the appeal of owning a piece of D-Wave. At face value, who wouldn't want to invest in a leading quantum computing company that's betting everything on its ability to develop some of the most advanced computing systems ever to exist?

The company has recently scored some meaningful wins, too, including a 1,120% increase in bookings to $35.5 million in the second quarter. Bookings are potential revenue, not actual sales yet, but they are a good indicator that customers are very interested in D-Wave's quantum annealing technology.

AT&T is one such customer that has just agreed to expand its use of D-Wave's quantum computers, and may use them for "complex optimization challenges across its network operations." The telecom will experiment with the tech to improve its outage detection and response, manage technician routes, and plan new network expansions.

But bookings aren't sales, and D-Wave's revenue in the quarter was just $3 million. Revenue for most quantum computing pure-play companies is lumpy because they rely on large contracts that don't come regularly. The company also isn't profitable and likely won't be for many more years, given its limited customer base and the investments it is making in developing its quantum computing technology.

That makes D-Wave a pretty risky bet right now, especially since the company's shares are trading at a hefty premium. D-Wave's stock has a price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of 610, which is drastically more expensive than the average P/S ratio of about 8 for companies in the technology sector.

Why Microsoft is a better quantum computing stock

Story Continues

Microsoft is best known these days as a leading AI player, but it has also made some big strides in quantum computing. For example, Microsoft developed what it calls a topological superconductor, or topoconductor, that can create more stable qubits -- the fundamental units of computation for quantum computers.

The processor that it has built around these topoconductors, Majorana 1, is expected to eventually help Microsoft scale up to 1 million qubits on a single processor. That's a goal many companies have set because at that scale, a fault-tolerant quantum computer would be capable of handling what the company describes as "transformative, real-world solutions."

What's more, Microsoft has already commercialized its Azure cloud system for quantum computing services. With Azure Quantum, companies can rent the service for advanced research. It's an early indicator of how Microsoft will use its successful Azure cloud business to sell quantum computing services in the coming years.

This is especially important for investors because in its fiscal 2026, which ended June 30, Azure surpassed $100 billion in annual sales (up 41% from fiscal 2025). Microsoft remains the second-largest cloud infrastructure player, behind Amazon . This means that Azure's growing success makes it more likely that customers will naturally migrate to additional Microsoft quantum computing services as they become available.

And if all that isn't convincing enough, Microsoft reported $4.74 in earnings per share in fiscal Q4, and $19.6 billion in free cash flow. At a time when investors are growing skeptical that big tech's large investments are paying off, Microsoft has proved that it knows how to develop new technology without breaking the bank.

Oh, and its shares are well-priced, too. Microsoft's stock trades at a price-to-earnings ratio of just 27 compared to the tech sector's average of 36.

All of this makes Microsoft a great quantum computing stock to hold as the quantum computing market develops over the next five years.

news.Title: Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights: Palantir, Micron and SpaceX
news.Content:
For Immediate Release

Chicago, IL – August 19, 2026 – Today, Zacks Investment Ideas feature highlights Palantir Technologies PLTR, Micron Technology MU and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. SPCX.

Palantir, SpaceX and Micron: Buy, Hold or Sell?

Palantir Technologies , Micron Technology and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. represent three of the most compelling companies in the market today, each sitting at the center of some of the world's most important investment themes. They also generate unusually wide disagreement among investors, attracting both exuberant bulls and deeply skeptical bears.

Palantir and SpaceX are two of the most richly valued large-cap companies in the market. Both are led by outspoken, contrarian founders, operate businesses that are difficult to fit neatly into traditional frameworks and face few direct competitors at comparable scale. At the same time, both are growing exceptionally fast and are exposed to enormous secular tailwinds across artificial intelligence, space, defense, data infrastructure and government spending.

Micron presents a different, but similarly difficult, valuation question. The company has emerged as one of the most critical beneficiaries of the AI data center buildout, particularly through the explosive demand for advanced memory. That investment case was much easier to make a year ago. Following a nearly 10x increase in the stock, however, determining how much upside remains has become considerably more complicated.

I will break down each company in greater detail below, but the short version is this: Palantir stands out as the most compelling buy, followed by SpaceX, as both continue to show exceptional business momentum and favorable price action. Micron looks more like a hold. The company should continue to perform well, but I believe the memory cycle is much closer to maturity, while capital within the AI boom is likely to migrate toward the next supply-constrained corners of the ecosystem.

Palantir Technologies: The Emerging AI Juggernaut

Palantir Technologies reported earnings a couple of weeks ago, and the results were outstanding. Revenue surged 93% year over year, while earnings jumped 225%, reinforcing the company's position as one of the fastest-growing large-cap companies.

CEO Alex Karp has also begun drawing a sharper distinction between Palantir and the major AI labs, framing the company's technology as a sovereign AI solution for corporate America and the government. His argument is that institutions need to capture the benefits of AI without sacrificing control of their data, intellectual property or business models.

Story Continues

Karp has repeatedly criticized the large AI labs for effectively turning the information users and businesses provide them into training data, warning that valuable intellectual property could be handed over on a silver platter. It is certainly a reasonable concern, and also a convenient one for Palantir's business model.

More importantly, customers appear to be responding. Net dollar retention reached 157% in the most recent quarter, showing that existing customers are dramatically expanding their spending as Palantir moves beyond Foundry and deeper into its AI offerings. This will be one of the most important metrics to watch going forward, as it provides a falsifiable test of whether demand for more private, sovereign AI is translating into sustained spending.

Today, Palantir carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) , with earnings estimates rising roughly 7% across the board. Meanwhile, the stock trades near 80x next year's earnings—undeniably expensive, but well below the multiples it has commanded through much of its history as a public company. With the share price going essentially nowhere over the past year while revenue and earnings have continued to compound rapidly, the valuation has compressed considerably.

The technical setup is compelling as well. PLTR recently broke out from a massive year-long bullish wedge following earnings. A brief period of consolidation would not be surprising, but the setup increasingly favors another leg higher and a move toward new record highs.

Among these three names, Palantir stands out as the most compelling opportunity. The valuation remains rich, but the combination of extraordinary growth, expanding profitability, rising earnings estimates and a stock that has spent the past year consolidating is difficult to ignore. Palantir increasingly looks like it is becoming a core AI layer across corporations and government, and the stock may begin to reflect this new narrative.

SpaceX: Hyperscaler Acceleration Plus Rockets and Satellites

Going into the IPO, I was skeptical of SpaceX, and I am glad I stayed away through the initial boom and bust. Following the company's recent earnings report, however, my view has changed. The valuation remains demanding, but the combination of accelerating growth, powerful thematic exposure and renewed investor enthusiasm makes the stock increasingly compelling.

The latest earnings report was the catalyst. Revenue surged 92% year over year, net losses narrowed sharply and EBITDA jumped 191%. Starlink, the company's primary cash-generating engine, continued to expand rapidly, with revenue up 66%, operating income rising 79% and subscriptions roughly doubling. The launch business also contributed solidly, growing 29% year over year.

The most interesting development, however, came from AI and cloud. Revenue from the segment surged 248% to $2.56 billion, and Musk is leaning aggressively into the opportunity, projecting nearly $50 billion in capital spending and targeting $100 billion in annual revenue by year-end. SpaceX also enters this expansion from a position of considerable financial strength, with roughly $100 billion in cash and marketable securities.

That shift matters because the AI narrative appears to be strengthening again following the recent semiconductor correction, and I increasingly suspect the hyperscalers could lead the next phase of the trade. Amazon, Microsoft and Meta have already demonstrated that massive AI investments can coexist with accelerating revenue and expanding margins. SpaceX is now positioning itself alongside that group.

For much of the past year, the central question surrounding AI spending has been simple: where is the return on all this capex? This earnings season provided considerably more evidence that the hyperscalers are beginning to generate it, while computing capacity remains constrained. If that trend continues, SpaceX's combination of data centers, connectivity, launch infrastructure and enormous capital resources could place it near the center of the next major phase of AI investment.

The technical picture is encouraging as well. After correcting sharply from its IPO highs, the stock spent several months building a substantial base. Shares have since broken out decisively and are now forming what looks like a bull-flag consolidation. I would watch those consolidation levels closely for another potential continuation move.

SpaceX looks attractive following the selloff. The valuation is still rich, but business momentum is accelerating and the company has now added another major growth narrative through its data center ambitions. The shareholder base is also unusually enthusiastic, which can provide meaningful support when operating momentum is moving in the right direction.

Share unlocks remain a legitimate risk, but the early evidence has been encouraging. The tradable float more than doubled, from roughly 639 million shares to 1.55 billion, yet the stock still gained about 11% over two days. For now, the market appears more interested in the improving fundamental story than the additional supply.

Micron Technologies: AI Winner May See Moderating Stock Performance

Micron has undergone one of the most remarkable ascents in the technology sector in recent years. It has been extraordinary to watch not only the stock's rise, but the acceleration in the underlying business as well. In the most recent quarter, earnings surged 693% year over year while revenue jumped 346%, as booming demand and sharply higher pricing for advanced memory briefly made Micron one of the most critical suppliers in the entire AI infrastructure buildout.

That kind of growth is highly unusual for a company of Micron's scale, and the stock's enormous appreciation over the past year has reflected it. The fundamental outlook remains strong, but Micron is still operating in a deeply cyclical industry. More importantly, the AI boom has repeatedly rotated from one supply-constrained component to the next. Memory has been the most recent major beneficiary, and I suspect the largest phase of that trade is now behind us.

That does not mean Micron is headed for a major decline. Rather, I expect the stock to transition from a major relative leader toward something closer to market performance, whether measured against the semiconductor group or the Nasdaq.

Nvidia offers a useful comparison. Its explosive gains in 2023 and 2024 marked the most dramatic phase of the trade. The stock has continued to perform well since then, but the magnitude of the gains has moderated considerably. Something similar may now be in store for Micron: continued fundamental strength and potentially solid absolute returns, but without the extraordinary outperformance of the past year.

The technical picture supports that view. After its enormous advance, MU appears likely to spend some time working through a broad consolidation, with choppier and more sideways price action as fundamentals catch up with the stock.

Valuation also deserves some caution. At roughly 13x forward earnings, Micron looks exceptionally cheap on the surface. But cyclical companies often appear cheapest near the strongest part of the earnings cycle, when profits and estimates are elevated. This may ultimately prove to be a longer-lasting AI-driven supercycle, so that does not imply an imminent collapse in earnings or the stock. It does, however, make the headline multiple less compelling than it first appears.

Still, the cyclical nature of the memory business will eventually come to roost, even if that point remains some distance away. I do not expect memory pricing or demand to remain this strong indefinitely. Eventually, supply will catch up, pricing will normalize and growth rates will moderate. The difficult question is not whether that happens, but when. For now, AI demand may extend the cycle considerably longer than historical precedent would suggest, but investors should be careful not to extrapolate today's extraordinary conditions indefinitely.

Micron is therefore the hardest of these three stocks for me to make a strong bullish case for today. The business remains excellent and AI demand remains powerful, but memory has already enjoyed its turn as the market's critical supply constraint. I expect capital and investor attention to increasingly seek out the next bottleneck in the data center buildout. Micron can still perform well, but the extraordinary phase of its run is likely behind it, making the stock a hold rather than a buy at current levels.

Should Investors Buy, Hold or Sell Shares of SPCX, PLTR and MU?

All three companies remain major beneficiaries of powerful secular trends, but the investment setups are very different today.

Palantir is my favorite of the three, with exceptional growth, improving profitability and a technical breakout that could mark the beginning of its next major move. SpaceX is also attractive, particularly as its rapidly growing AI and cloud ambitions add another dimension to an already unique collection of businesses, though its valuation leaves less room for error.

Micron remains a hold. The company is executing exceptionally well, but memory has already experienced an extraordinary cycle of demand, pricing and investor enthusiasm. Those conditions can persist longer than expected, but they will not last forever.

The broader lesson is that leadership within the AI boom continues to rotate. Rather than chasing yesterday's biggest winner, investors may be better served looking for where the next wave of growth, scarcity and capital is beginning to emerge.

news.Title: 台股千點殺盤！後市「關鍵訊號」曝光 散戶別急著殺進去
news.Content:
美伊衝突與通膨疑慮未歇，使30年期美債殖利率走高，引發美國科技股與晶片股重挫，台股今（19日）也受到衝擊，早盤暴跌千點。事實上，台股已經從7月底的低點反彈超過6千點，漲多面臨回檔整理並不令人意外，財經專家阮慕驊於臉書撰文指出，後市觀察重點在櫃買指數的月線。

後市觀察5大重點 櫃買成風向球

台股昨（18日）出現獲利了結賣壓，正式跌破5日線、回測10日線，櫃買指數更是失守10日線，距離月線379.13點支撐只剩11.7點，因此阮慕驊認為，今天櫃買指數能否守住379將是關鍵。

另外，後市觀察重點，阮慕驊指出，櫃買指數反彈至今剛好收復一半，技術上多空最容易拉鋸的位置，另外在動能上也有所減弱，「MACD的DIF -0.23一路上來卻在零軸前熄火，紅柱明顯縮短。指標在零軸前轉折，通常代表什麼？」

台股打第二隻腳？後市再下殺？

除此之外，阮慕驊表示，籌碼結構也出現轉折點，且資金沒走只是換族群。外資結束連6買、轉為賣超119.86億，自營商避險賣壓增加，對比前一天指數只漲46點、外資卻買超454億」的換手盤，結構明顯轉弱。

針對台股後市，分析師林漢偉指出，全球高成長科技股賣壓，加上台指期結算影響，電子權值股面臨壓低結算壓力；中小型股則要特別留意近期漲多個股的獲利了結賣壓，短線操作不宜追高。

分析師張大文則提到，8月以來的反攻進入第二階段，台股46K本就是多空分水嶺，現階段操作必須汰弱留強保留一定現金，控制節奏避免盲目追價，有計畫進出資金效率最大化。

news.Title: 唐吉訶德旺、PPIH獲利續破紀錄 惟財測遜、股價崩
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-19 10:04:29 蔡承啟 發佈

營運日本知名折扣商店「唐吉訶德(Don Quijote)」等事業的Pan Pacific International Holdings(以下簡稱PPIH、7532.JP)獲利續破紀錄，不過今年度財測遜於市場預期，PPIH今日股價崩跌。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間19日上午9點55分為止，PPIH崩跌11.21%至812.9日圓。

PPIH 18日於日股盤後公布上年度(2025年7月-2026年6月)財報：因唐吉訶德等折扣店事業銷售強勁，帶動合併營收年增8.8%至2兆4,453億日圓，連續第37年呈現增長、續創歷史新高紀錄；合併營益成長7.7%至1,748億日圓，連續第37年呈現增長、續創歷史新高紀錄；合併純益大增21.6%至1,101億日圓，年度別純益為史上首度突破1,000億日圓大關，連續第16年創下歷史新高。

PPIH指出，上年度唐吉訶德等折扣店事業(DS事業)營收年增7.3%至1兆5,507億日圓，營益年增6.6%至1,107億日圓，營益連續第2年高於1,000億日圓，續創歷史新高紀錄。其中，因來自歐美、亞洲的訪日觀光客需求增加，免稅銷售額暴增31.2%至2,286億日圓、創下歷史新高紀錄。

上年度PPIH總合超市事業(UNY事業)營收成長1.9%至4,794億日圓、營益減少3.7%至340億日圓。

PPIH表示，截至2026年6月底為止PPIH集團總門市數為799家、較1年前(2025年6月底)增加20家，其中日本國內門市數為676家、海外為123家。

展望今年度(2026年7月-2027年6月)業績，PPIH預估合併營收將年增9.9%至2兆6,870億日圓，將連續第38年呈現增長、續創歷史新高；合併營益預估將年增2.4%至1,790億日圓，將連續第38年呈現增長、續創歷史新高；合併純益將年增0.4%至1,105億日圓、將連續第17年創下歷史新高。

日經新聞報導，分析師平均預估PPIH今年度純益將為1,226億日圓。PPIH公布的預估值遜於市場預期。

news.Title: 台股大屠殺！開盤暴跌千點 台積電狂殺40元、記憶體重災
news.Content:
由於油價走高，在通膨疑慮升溫下，帶動全球公債殖利率創數十年新高，半導體類股急遽拉回，衝擊美股4大指數重挫，亞股血腥屠殺，韓股暴跌逾6%觸及熔斷，日股下殺逾2000點，台股今（19）日開盤大跌千點，最低來到44308.71點。

電子權值股成重災區，台積電跌40元至2340元，聯發科重挫2.7%，台達電跌3%，聯電跌4%，記憶體股成重災區，南亞科跌6%。部分航運股成資金避風港，新興漲逾2%。

林漢偉分析師表示，台股今日面臨漲多回檔壓力，美債殖利率創下波段新高，引發全球高成長科技股賣壓，加上台指期結算影響，電子權值股面臨壓低結算壓力；中小型股則要特別留意漲多個股的獲利了結賣壓，短線操作不宜追高。

林漢偉分析師指出，台股今回測季線支撐，因適逢台指期結算，尾盤特別留意結算方向。外資現貨轉為賣超，但期貨空單持續減少，籌碼面維持中性偏空；櫃買指數回測月線支撐，記憶體、IC設計與矽光子成為主要壓盤族群。

台股昨日挑戰4萬6千點失利，終場下挫548點，收在45308點。外資終結連6買，轉手賣超台股119.85億元。

美股道瓊下跌116.38點或0.22%，收53,343.40點。S&P500下跌53.30點或0.69%，收7,691.76點。NASDAQ下跌355.20點或1.33%，收26,289.71點。費城半導體下跌628.54點或4.98%，收11,992.46點。

news.Title: 【統一證券晨訊】全球債市承壓拖累股市　台股防壓低結算
news.Content:
日期：2026年 8月19日

※盤勢分析

全球債市承壓拖累股市，台股月線具支撐，今提防壓低結算

※昨日盤勢

美伊諒解備忘錄到期、中東衝突猶存導致油價上漲，干擾投資人情緒。儘管

費半指數持續上漲，然周二台股早盤開平高盤後，追價買盤意願薄弱，成交量無

法有效放大，獲利賣壓出籠，終場呈現開高走低收黑並失守5日線。AI族群普遍

遭遇漲多獲利賣壓表現疲弱，散裝航因運價反映戰爭風險溢酬相關個股表現相對

強勢。權值股方面，台積電下跌0.83%、鴻海下跌2.35%、聯發科下跌4.07%、廣

達下跌1.95%，台達電下跌3.45%。

盤面強勢股，益航、四維航、光鼎、長華*、崇越電、陽程、大量、雲豹能

源等共17檔漲停；德宏、中華化、冠西電、美而快、柏承、台虹等漲幅7%以上。

盤面弱勢股，鈺創、森寶、西勝、鑫創等跌停；京晨科、晶豪科、旺矽、百徽、

萬潤等跌幅9%以上。終場台灣加權指數下跌548.59點，以45308.68點作收，成交

量9584.44億元。

觀察盤面變化，三大類股漲跌互見，電子下跌1.52%、傳產下跌0.14%、金融

上漲0.73%。在次族群部份以航運、油電燃氣、食品表現較佳，分別上漲2.09%、

1.01%、0.85%。

※資金動向

三大法人合計賣超257.66億元。其中外資賣超119.86億元，投信買超38.27

億元，自營商賣超176.07億元。外資買超前五大為長榮、漢翔、陽明、三商壽、

富邦金；賣超前五大為力積電、友達、群創、台新新光金、凱基金。投信買超前

五大為台新新光金、凱基金、玉山金、永豐金、第一金；賣超前五大為旺宏、台

塑化、鴻海、日月光投控、元大金。資券變化方面，融資減30.9億元，融資餘額

為5470.11億元，融券減1.38萬張，融券餘額為20.45萬張。外資台指期部位，空

單減少468口，淨空單部位83078口，借券賣出金額247.25億元。成交比重：電子

87.29%、傳產9.99%、金融2.72%。

※今日盤勢分析

外媒報導，Alphabet、Meta、甲骨文等九家大型科技公司支出總額遠高於其

揭露的資本支出數據，還有約3兆美元的「隱藏帳單」未反映於資產負債表，引

發投資人擔憂。隨著油價攀升逾近兩週高點，全球債市承受沉重賣壓，市場對AI

題材的樂觀情緒降溫及企業融資成本上升的疑慮加劇，半導體類股成為昨晚拋售

重災區。週二美股四大指數皆墨，台積電ADR下跌4.07%，台指期夜盤下跌561點

台股後市分析如下：第一、全球AI基礎建設競賽，正從單一晶片較勁，全面

升級為系統與生態系之戰。SEMICON Taiwan 2026大師論壇暨全球生態系高峰會9

月2日將迎來焦點爐邊對談，首度集結台灣AI供應鏈「五虎將」，由日月光、台

積電、聯發科、鴻海及欣興五大領袖同台，串起IC設計、晶圓製造、先進封裝、

IC載板及AI伺服器五大環節，展現台灣從晶片到系統的全鏈輸出實力。

第二、AI算力與機架功率持續攀升，資料中心供電瓶頸正由「需要多少電」

，進一步轉向「如何把電有效送進GPU」，帶動既有配電架構加速升級。輝達（

NVIDIA）最新揭示800VDC發展藍圖，透過提高直流配電（DC）電壓、減少電力轉

換環節，支撐更高密度AI運算需求。隨相關架構逐步落地，電源雙雄台達電、光

寶科高壓直流電布局也將自下半年起陸續發酵。

第三、技術面觀察，週二加權指數量微縮黑K失守5日線，技術指標KD、RSI

高檔轉折向下，MACD紅柱體縮小，成交量低於1兆，短線上面臨震盪整理，後續

指數欲上攻須放量，下檔季線具支撐。

第四、盤面資金聚焦散裝航、部分PCB設備，包括益航、四維航、陽程、大

量等表現強勢。

※投資策略

油價攀升、全球債市承壓，半導體類股遭衝擊，市場靜待本週FOMC會議紀要

指引利率路徑。台股受惠輝達Rubin量產及機器人展今日開展等利多，月線至季

線44000-44500具強勁支撐；然8月上演反彈，成交量遲無有效放大，顯示指數上

攻追價力道不足，搭配日KD及RSI指標高檔轉折向下，短線面臨震盪整理。今日

適逢台指期結算，外資台指期淨空單仍逾8.3萬口，須嚴防壓低結算之劇烈波動

操作建議「逢低布局、反彈汰弱留強」，選股以流動性佳的中大型AI權值股

為主。長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進製程/封裝、載板與PCB、電源管理相關、機

箱滑軌、機器人概念、特用化學及自行車等族群。

news.Title: 統一證券：台股短線面臨震盪整理
news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

美伊諒解備忘錄到期、中東衝突猶存導致油價上漲，干擾投資人情緒。儘管費半指數持續上漲，然周二台股早盤開平高盤後，追價買盤意願薄弱，成交量無法有效放大，獲利賣壓出籠，終場呈現開高走低收黑並失守5日線。AI族群普遍遭遇漲多獲利賣壓表現疲弱，散裝航因運價反映戰爭風險溢酬相關個股表現相對強勢。權值股方面，台積電下跌0.83%、鴻海下跌2.35%、聯發科下跌4.07%、廣達下跌1.95%，台達電下跌3.45%。盤面強勢股，益航、四維航、光鼎、長華*、崇越電、陽程、大量、雲豹能源等共17檔漲停；德宏、中華化、冠西電、美而快、柏承、台虹等漲幅7%以上。盤面弱勢股，鈺創、森寶、西勝、鑫創等跌停；京晨科、晶豪科、旺矽、百徽、萬潤等跌幅9%以上。終場台灣加權指數下跌548.59點，以45308.68點作收，成交量9584.44億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股漲跌互見，電子下跌1.52%、傳產下跌0.14%、金融上漲0.73%。在次族群部份以航運、油電燃氣、食品表現較佳，分別上漲2.09%、1.01%、0.85%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計賣超257.66億元。其中外資賣超119.86億元，投信買超38.27億元，自營商賣超176.07億元。外資買超前五大為長榮、漢翔、陽明、三商壽、富邦金；賣超前五大為力積電、友達、群創、台新新光金、凱基金。投信買超前五大為台新新光金、凱基金、玉山金、永豐金、第一金；賣超前五大為旺宏、台塑化、鴻海、日月光投控、元大金。資券變化方面，融資減30.9億元，融資餘額為5470.11億元，融券減1.38萬張，融券餘額為20.45萬張。外資台指期部位，空單減少468口，淨空單部位83078口，借券賣出金額247.25億元。成交比重：電子87.29%、傳產9.99%、金融2.72%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

外媒報導，Alphabet、Meta、甲骨文等九家大型科技公司支出總額遠高於其揭露的資本支出數據，還有約3兆美元的「隱藏帳單」未反映於資產負債表，引發投資人擔憂。隨著油價攀升逾近兩週高點，全球債市承受沉重賣壓，市場對AI題材的樂觀情緒降溫及企業融資成本上升的疑慮加劇，半導體類股成為昨晚拋售重災區。週二美股四大指數皆墨，台積電ADR下跌4.07%，台指期夜盤下跌561點。台股後市分析如下：

第一、全球AI基礎建設競賽，正從單一晶片較勁，全面升級為系統與生態系之戰。SEMICON Taiwan 2026大師論壇暨全球生態系高峰會9月2日將迎來焦點爐邊對談，首度集結台灣AI供應鏈「五虎將」，由日月光、台積電、聯發科、鴻海及欣興五大領袖同台，串起IC設計、晶圓製造、先進封裝、IC載板及AI伺服器五大環節，展現台灣從晶片到系統的全鏈輸出實力。

第二、AI算力與機架功率持續攀升，資料中心供電瓶頸正由「需要多少電」，進一步轉向「如何把電有效送進GPU」，帶動既有配電架構加速升級。輝達（NVIDIA）最新揭示800VDC發展藍圖，透過提高直流配電（DC）電壓、減少電力轉換環節，支撐更高密度AI運算需求。隨相關架構逐步落地，電源雙雄台達電、光寶科高壓直流電布局也將自下半年起陸續發酵。

第三、技術面觀察，週二加權指數量微縮黑K失守5日線，技術指標KD、RSI高檔轉折向下，MACD紅柱體縮小，成交量低於1兆，短線上面臨震盪整理，後續指數欲上攻須放量，下檔季線具支撐。

四、盤面資金聚焦散裝航、部分PCB設備，包括益航、四維航、陽程、大量等表現強勢。

【投資策略】：

油價攀升、全球債市承壓，半導體類股遭衝擊，市場靜待本週FOMC會議紀要指引利率路徑。台股受惠輝達Rubin量產及機器人展今日開展等利多，月線至季線44000-44500具強勁支撐；然8月上演反彈，成交量遲無有效放大，顯示指數上攻追價力道不足，搭配日KD及RSI指標高檔轉折向下，短線面臨震盪整理。今日適逢台指期結算，外資台指期淨空單仍逾8.3萬口，須嚴防壓低結算之劇烈波動。操作建議「逢低布局、反彈汰弱留強」，選股以流動性佳的中大型AI權值股為主。長線追蹤族群：台積電及先進製程/封裝、載板與PCB、電源管理相關、機箱滑軌、機器人概念、特用化學及自行車等族群。

資料來源- MoneyDJ理財網

news.Title: 費半急殺4.98%拖累，日經指數早盤急挫3%，鎧俠跌逾10%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國晶片與AI硬體股週二遭遇全面拋售，費城半導體指數重挫4.98%，拖累東京股市週三低開後跌勢加劇。日經225指數盤中跌幅擴大至3%，科技及半導體權值股成為主要賣壓來源。記憶體大廠鎧俠(Kioxia)暴跌超過10%，軟銀集團亦重挫逾6%。鎧俠受到美國儲存類股全面回檔拖累，SanDisk、希捷科技、SK海力士ADR、威騰電子與美光科技週二跌幅介於7%至9.2%，資金同步撤離近期漲幅較大的AI記憶體供應鏈。

軟銀集團則因持有安謀並大舉布局OpenAI及AI基礎設施，股價對美國科技股與AI估值變化高度敏感。週二安謀在美股重挫6.7%，加上美國30年期公債殖利率升至2007年以來高點，市場重新評估高估值成長股的資本成本與折現壓力。

日股此波下跌主要是隔夜美國半導體股急挫的連動效應，而非日本企業集中出現新利空。美伊僵局推升油價及全球通膨風險，日本10年期公債殖利率亦處於約30年高位，使晶片股同時承受美國同業大跌、利率升高與獲利回吐三重壓力。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台股夜盤崩近600點能搶便宜？輝達點名「16家台廠」名單曝光
news.Content:
小編今天（19）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。受美股費城半導體指數崩跌近 5%、台積電 ADR 下挫 4% 衝擊，台指期夜盤今（19）日大跌 561 點（跌幅 1.24%），收在 44527 點，台積電期貨盤後也同步走低 34 點。法人分析，除了季線為關鍵防守線外，7 月 31 日收盤價 43,119 點也是重要支撐區，預期指數將在此處築底、「打第二隻腳」的防線。

在台股回檔之際，輝達（NVIDIA）點名包括研華、台達、新漢智能等16家台廠，將共同攜手於19日登場的2026台北國際自動化工業大展，展出物理AI、數位孿生、自主移動機器人（AMR）、協作型機械手臂及人形機器人方案，凸顯台灣供應鏈積極搶進機器人運算、模擬訓練與邊緣AI商機。

【1】輝達點名16台廠 大秀物理AI

輝達指出，工業自動化正邁入全新階段，生成式AI、物理AI、模擬、合成資料與加速運算等技術快速發展，正逐步整合為串聯虛擬工廠、機器人學習、邊緣推論與實際營運的完整工作流程。

【2】群創下階段騰籠換鳥拚FOPLP

群創舉行法說會，董事長洪進揚表示，今年出售二廠和五廠之後，對外處分暫時告一段落。下一階段將「騰籠換鳥」，因應FOPLP產能擴充，將啟動內部廠區的調整。至於FOPLP發展狀況，去年一個月出貨約4,000萬顆，今年月出貨量還有雙位數的成長。

【3】搶艙潮湧 Q3運價有望雙位數增

第三季除旺季需求穩健，在五大不可控因素加持下：美伊衝突升溫促使業者急單搶出貨、巴拿馬運河水位下降限航、紅海航道持續受阻、荷姆茲海峽通航受限，以及全球主要港口壅塞，航運運價持續走揚，海運業者18日指出，鑑於美伊衝突升溫，貨主擔心供應鏈再添變數，市場已出現部分恐慌性急單，強勁的搶艙需求有望再推升運價走勢。

【4】操作偏空 守穩季線成指標

第一金投顧董事長黃詣庭認為，只要季線44,794點支撐力道夠強，大盤大幅下殺可能性就不高，至於中東戰事方面，需留意油價受到的影響，若油價突破每桶100美元，就要重新評估對通膨及股市影響，預估月底前市場維持觀望格局，尚未出現完全翻空的訊號，建議滿倉投資人，可小幅減少3至4成部位，若指數拉回至季線附近且能守穩，則可擇優布局。

【5】3大原因夾殺 美日歐長債殖利率飆

中東緊張局勢遲遲未見緩解，布蘭特油價重回90美元關卡，引發市場對通膨居高不下的擔憂，加上多國政府財政紀律惡化與債務壓力升高，加劇全球債券拋售潮。美歐日長天期公債殖利率連袂走高、改寫數十年新高。

news.Title: 債市殖利率上揚引發美股下跌，週三台股恐受影響
news.Content:
【財訊快報／魏聖峰】債市殖利率攀升，市場對AI題材想像力暫時消失，先前好不容易重返牛市的費城半導體指數週二下跌，擔心CSP業者今年龐大的資本支出一旦碰到市場殖利率上揚，恐將衝擊CSP業者的財務狀況。超微股價大跌4.27%、NVIDIA股價下挫2.34%、博通股價重挫3.17%、美光科技股價大跌7.02%、新帝股價大跌9.01%、威騰電子股價大跌7.43%、SK海力士ADR股價大跌9.2%。台積電ADR股價下挫4.07%、日月光投控ADR股價大跌8.77%、聯電ADR股價大跌5.38%。以週二美股表現來看，週三亞洲股市和台股恐將受到殖利率上揚衝擊，影響表現。近期受到美伊和平談判遲遲沒有達成協議，造成國際油價的反彈，週二亞洲股市呈現開高走低格局，並對週二台股開高後一路下殺，收盤時加權指數下跌1.2%，以45308.68點作收，櫃買指數更下跌1.88%，來到390.83點作收。短線市場沒有明顯利多，市場追價意願不高情況下反殺，形成週二台股的跌勢。即便如此，市場也沒有明顯的利空消息，短線指數殺下來後，也不太會容易形成連續性殺盤。週三收盤是八月台指期結算日，外資仍有超過8.3萬口空單，由於歐美公債殖利率仍持續攀高，外資的空單暫時不會大幅減少，最近外資在期貨市場的操作也把空單轉倉到九月期。

從加權指數的技術型態來看，週三指數跌破5日線後下檔在45180點有10日線支撐，假如週三台股沒有反彈，短線的空方力道會轉強，指數能否守住45000點是短線多頭很重要的防線。週二加權指數開高一度在46000點以上，市場追價意願不高，指數跌破46000點。當前的成交量遲遲沒有明顯連續性遞增也是大盤攻不上去的主因，台股短線會不會好轉，要看國際股市的臉色。日股、韓股和費城半導體數是影響台股趨勢最重要的觀察指標，這三大指數多頭力道沒有強彈，台股也會轉而震盪整理格局。

台積電(2330)在ADR股價沒有強彈情況下呈現震盪整理，老AI的鴻海(2317)、廣達(2382)、緯創(3231)、英業達(2356)、仁寶(2324)全面拉回。矽智財的聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)、世芯-KY(3661)也拉回。聯電(2303)、力積電(6770)、世界先進(5347)也是回檔，權值股幾乎跌多漲少，衝擊加權指數表現。高價股的川湖(2059)、信驊(5274)、大立光(3008)上漲，成為短線支撐指數的多頭力道。短線最強的ABF及CCL族群中，週二只有欣興(3037)及聯茂(6213)上漲，其他都下跌，臻鼎-KY(4958)週二股價大跌5.77%，影響市場追價ABF的意願；週三強勢族群的ABF和CCL是否有轉強機會，攸關台股短線強弱表現。

矽光子類股以聯鈞(3450)、聯亞(3081)、IET(4971)股價表現最好。AI供應鏈勤誠(8210)、金像電(2368)、富世達(6805)、光寶科(2301)、貿聯-KY(3665)翻紅。功率半導體從上游的茂矽(2342)、中美晶(5483)、環球晶圓(6488)到大中(6435)、台半(5425)表現較強且整齊。設備股有由田(3455)、大量(3167)表現較好。

傳產股以台塑四寶表現較佳，航運股則有貨櫃的長榮(2603)、陽明(2609)、萬海(2615)表現最強。

news.Title: 台股13檔「千張大戶」偷跑了！記憶體最慘 自救方法曝光
news.Content:
台股曾在7月跌破4萬點，但進入8月後短短三周已反彈至46K關卡附近，持續進行高檔整理，資金在人工智慧、記憶體、半導體及光通訊等族群流竄，分析師陳唯泰篩選出13檔財報亮眼卻出現千張大戶減持的個股，提醒投資人留意。

記憶體、AI遭狙擊 後市有危險？

陳唯泰利用上半年賺超過一個股本，且第二季EPS大於第一季的兩大條件挑出66檔績優股，指標股包括群聯、緯穎及川湖。陳唯泰認為，「這三檔是接下來台股能否持續走高的關鍵，如果好公司不漲，這樣的行情也撐不久。」

陳唯泰從66檔績優股進一步分析大戶動向，其中39檔遭大戶減碼，記憶體族群與高估值的設備材料股為重災區，依照減持幅度排名，包括群聯、威剛、亞翔、宇瞻、創見、萬潤、十銓、譜瑞-KY、竹陞科技、宜鼎、凌航、文曄及台達電等13檔。

持股中鏢不要慌 操作指標曝光

其中群聯的減持幅度最高，達10.81%。對於千張大戶減持，陳唯泰認為不能直接判斷為主力出貨，也有可能是大股東想要避稅，尤其前陣子剛好是除權息旺季，如果是此狀況還要進一步觀察動向。

陳唯泰分析指出，「需要觀察未來一兩周有沒有回補持股，如果回補就沒有太大問題，如果沒有動作就要特別小心，尤其是股本比較小（150億或100億以下）的公司，大戶減持多少會造成影響。」

如果技術面偏弱，這一波反彈也未站穩均線的個股，陳唯泰建議先列入觀察名單，必須花時間整理使籌碼沉澱，等待拉回或轉強訊號出現再布局。

news.Title: 台股強震築底 AI光通訊與高填息策略雙支柱
news.Content:
【記者柯安聰台北報導】美伊備忘錄到期且談話尚未達成協議，市場對地緣政治衝突再起的疑慮升溫，美股3大指數承壓收黑；台股18日收盤下跌548.59點，跌幅1.2%，終場以45308.68點作收，成交量9584億元，大盤指數跌破5日均線。然而，科技股表現獨強，美商商務部提振記憶體政策激勵美光上漲，台積電ADR亦收紅1.08%，帶動費城半導體指數強勢上漲1.64%，仍為台股多頭提供有力支撐。大華銀投信表示，台股多頭架構尚未遭到破壞，建議採「汰弱留強、逢震盪布局」策略，優先聚焦具獲利支撐、供需改善及漲價題材族群。

大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管暨大華優利高填息30(00918)經理人郭修誠表示，雖然國內外財報公布告一段落，市場暫時缺乏強烈利多刺激，但台股技術面已成功重回多頭格局。目前指數進入高檔區間，資金操作轉趨謹慎，日成交量若能進一步擴增至1兆元以上，將更加有利於大盤延續向上攻勢。盤面上，資金持續聚焦AI與機器人概念股，包括載板、光通訊及相關材料族群表現尤為亮眼。

郭修誠從最新產業供應鏈趨勢分析，隨著全球AI資料中心持續擴建，GPU與ASIC運算效能躍升推動資料傳輸需求爆發，光通訊規格正加速由800G升級至1.6T、乃至3.2T。其中，具備高速、高頻與優異光電轉換特性的磷化銦（InP）成為關鍵雷射與光偵測器材料；在矽光子與CPO架構推進下，連續波雷射（CW Laser）與電吸收調變雷射（EML）需求強勁，加上InP基板供給相對受限，呈現供需雙重的成長利多，預期「光進銅退」與高速光模組將成為2026至2028年的核心成長產業。

整體而言，郭修誠表示，台股近期雖面臨國際地緣政治變數與短線量能收縮，但基本面依然穩固，AI相關供應鏈營運動能強勁。面對高檔震盪且主流輪動的市場環境，投資策略應秉持「基本面成長」與「高股息防禦」雙軌並重。00918在成分股篩選上精準鎖定具高ROE獲利能力與高歷史填息率的企業，全面涵蓋AI供應鏈、光通訊技術要角以及獲利穩健的金融與傳產龍頭，能有效幫助投資人於波動中抵禦風險，並在下半年行情中掌握填息與資本利得的雙重契機。（自立電子報2026/8/18）

news.Title: 台股先行指標找到了？阮慕驊揭「周三關鍵」一句話：看這指數守不守得住月線
news.Content: 財經專家 阮慕驊 指出， 台股 真正的訊號不在加權指數，而在櫃買指數，19日的關鍵只有一句話：櫃買指數379守不守得住。示意圖。（資料照，劉偉宏攝） ​加權指數18日開高走低，早盤一度重返4萬6000點，隨後加權指數急殺翻黑，終場收在4萬5308.68點，下跌548.59點，外資及陸資也終止連續6個交易日買超，轉為賣超新台幣119.85億元。對此，財經專家阮慕驊於臉書發文指出，台股真正的訊號不在加權指數，而在櫃買指數，19日的關鍵只有一句話：櫃買指數379守不守得住。 中小型股早一步透露資金溫度？ 阮慕驊表示，18日台股跌548點，但真正的訊號不在加權指數，而在櫃買。加權指數跌破5日線、回測10日線；櫃買已經失守10日線、直接站在月線頭上，中小型股永遠比大盤早一步告訴你資金的溫度。 後續盤勢5大主軸 阮慕驊指出，主軸一：位置。距離月線只剩11.7點，櫃買收390.83，月線379.13，正乖離僅3.09%。這不是會不會回測，是已經貼在門口。均線結構被夾住，月線379撐在下面、10日線394剛剛跌破、季線410壓在上面且仍下彎。當一個指數被夾在下彎的季線和月線之間，這種盤該用什麼心態面對？ 阮慕驊提到，主軸二：這波反彈的性質剛好收復一半。從459.56跌到322.74，跌136.82點；反彈到390.83，收復49.8%，幾乎分毫不差的半分位，這是技術上多空最容易拉鋸的位置。跌深反彈和趨勢翻多，投資人要怎麼分辨？季線沒收復之前，這波能叫多頭嗎？ ​動能已轉弱？​ 阮慕驊表示，主軸三：動能已在轉弱。RSI5跌破50中軸來到46.74，且已低於RSI10的50.98，短線動能領先轉弱。MACD的DIF -0.23一路上來卻在零軸前熄火，紅柱明顯縮短。指標在零軸前轉折，通常代表什麼？ 阮慕驊指出，主軸四：籌碼結構的轉折點。外資結束連6買、轉為賣超119.86億，自營商避險賣壓增加，對比前一天「指數只漲46點、外資卻買超454億」的換手盤，18日的結構明顯轉弱。外資由買轉賣，是短線調節還是趨勢改變？該怎麼觀察才不會誤判？

news.Title: 「台股高低點」能預測？阮慕驊曝重大發現：「這指數」走勢是關鍵
news.Content:
台股 加權指數 今（18）日開高走低，收盤下跌548點、收在45308點。示意圖。（資料照，陳品佑攝）

受美伊局勢影響，美股主要指數前一日全面下挫，也連帶影響亞股，台股加權指數今（18）日開高走低，收盤下跌548點、收在45308點。而財經專家 阮慕驊 指出，他分析「等權重指數」與加權指數之間的相互關係，並研究出一個能夠「推敲大盤高低點」的模式。

「等權重指數」為不論公司的大小或市值高低，將指數內的所有成分股賦予相同的權重，無論是大企業還是中小型股，每家公司對指數的影響力完全一致。

​等權重指數怎麼預測大盤高點？​

阮慕驊在節目《聽，阮大哥的！》表示，計算到7月31日為止，大盤加權指數今年的報酬率是46.9%、最大回檔16.4%；而1087檔上市股票組成的權重指數，報酬率僅11.7% ，但低點卻跟加權指數差不多，回檔達14%。可見在市場中，權值股漲的還是比較多，上市的等權重指數「抗漲不抗跌」。

阮慕驊提到，他對比過去2009年到2026年，等權重指數跟加權指數的波段高低點，在時間關係上的領先或落後，結果顯示，2020年以後兩者關係性越來越密切，反應時間越變越快。

阮慕驊指出，從實務結論上來講，不用猜誰先誰後，「只要兩個指數出現明顯分歧，就代表進入到頭部警戒了」，也就是說，只要兩個指數的走勢出現乖離，無論方向、誰漲誰跌，就要小心已經進入頭部區， 這是個重大發現。

不只頂部，加權指數低點也能預測？

阮慕驊也說，觀察過去經驗，還有另外一點發現，那就是等權重指數的低點「從來不落後」加權指數，也就是我們可以用等權重指數的低點，來判準大盤加權指數的底部。

阮慕驊強調，「當等權重指數出現最低點，基本上代表加權指數大致也到了，兩邊低點高度同步，這也是一個重要發現。」

news.Title: 台股收跌548點！ 網見三大法人籌碼嘆：體感像倒貨千億
news.Content:
台股今（18）早盤一度上漲逾百點、重新站回4萬6千點大關，但隨後賣壓湧現，指數一路翻黑，盤中最低下探45225點，終場下跌548點，收在45308點，跌幅1.2%，失守5日線，成交量約9500億元。三大法人合計賣超239.3億元。

自營商避險成最大賣壓

三大法人合計賣超239.3億元，結束前一交易日偏多格局。其中，外資及陸資今日買進3709.93億元、賣出3829.79億元，單日賣超119.85億元。自營商方面，自營買賣賣超21.73億元，避險部分更大幅賣超154.34億元，兩者合計賣超176.07億元，成為三大法人中賣壓最重的一方。相較之下，投信逆勢加碼，今日買進408.44億元、賣出351.81億元，買超56.62億元，成為盤面上唯一站在買方的法人。

投信狂買「金金金」

從投信買超標的來看，金融股幾乎包辦前9名，顯示在大盤拉回之際，投信明顯轉向防禦型資產。投信今日買超最多的是台新新光金，達25106張；其次為凱基金22147張、玉山金18674張、永豐金13974張、第一金13662張，接著還有群創、兆豐金、合庫金、華南金及中華電。此舉也引發PTT股民熱議，有網友直呼「金金金金大金棒」、「金融最後一棒」，也有人認為「金金金 防禦防起來」，認為投信提前卡位金融股、降低大盤回檔風險。

旺宏遭大砍封測也被調節

在投信今日賣超前10名中，科技股仍占多數。其中旺宏遭投信賣超17860張，成為今日最大賣超標的；其次為台塑化9538張、鴻海4370張、日月光投控3895張，另外還包括元大金、大成鋼、文曄、大聯大、京元電子及中信金。其中旺宏的賣超尤其受到PTT網友關注，不少人留言「99旺宏」、「又是旺宏」、「投信旺宏追高殺低喔」，顯示市場對投信近期在旺宏的操作頗有意見。也有網友注意到，投信今日一邊大買金融股，一邊調節封測、電子股，認為法人操作呈現明顯的「攻轉守」味道。

賣超與跌點不成比例

值得注意的是，今天三大法人合計僅賣超239.3億元，外資賣超也只有119.85億元，但台股卻重挫548點，讓不少PTT網友直呼「這樣可以跌500多點哦」、「誰在賣」、「體感像被倒貨1000E」。有網友認為，今天真正較大的賣壓來自自營商，留言「自營又在殺了」、「自營倒最多」，也有人指出「小兒賣一點就繃？」、「小兒不玩了」，認為外資實際賣超金額並不算特別龐大。此外，今天適逢台指期結算前夕，市場籌碼與短線交易情緒本就較為敏感，盤中指數在跌破關鍵價位後，賣壓進一步擴大，也讓部分網友認為市場恐慌程度明顯高於法人實際賣超金額。

news.Title: 永豐期貨：賣壓湧現！台股重挫548點
news.Content:
【財訊快報／編輯部】指數週二下跌548.59點，收在45308.68點，成交量1兆元。台指期下跌779點至45088點，逆價差為-220.68點。籌碼面部分，三大法人賣超239.3億元；而在台指期淨部位方面，三大法人淨空單減少40口至-4400口，其中外資淨空單減少396口至-83078口；十大交易人中的特定法人全月份台指期淨空單減少524口至-1130口。台股今日面臨顯著的漲多修正壓力。早盤大盤一度衝高至46,064點，但隨即遭遇沉重的獲利了結賣壓，指數一路震盪走低，盤中最低下探45,225點。終場加權指數重挫548.59點（-1.20%），收在45,308點，總成交量維持在9,584億元。盤面下跌家數高達1,016家，整體修正力道強勁。

盤面上，電子權值股與先前的強勢AI族群成為殺盤重心。台積電（2330）小跌0.83%收2,380元；而聯發科（-4.07%）、台達電（-3.45%）以及鴻海（-2.35%）等核心權值股皆出現明顯的拉回。此外，前幾日強勢的散熱指標奇鋐（-3.65%）與被動元件國巨（-5.26%）亦面臨短線籌碼調節。

不過，資金並未全面撤出，而是轉向具備防禦屬性與個別題材的標的。金融族群發揮了極佳的避險撐盤作用，富邦金（+3.19%）與國泰金（+1.12%）雙雙逆勢收紅；而在高價股方面，伺服器滑軌指標川湖（2059）完全無視大盤賣壓，強勢大漲 4.51%收14,370元續創天價，ABF 載板欣興（+2.23%）表現抗跌。

整體來看，大盤在經歷前波急攻與高檔震盪後，今日出現了一次極為徹底的技術面修正與籌碼清洗。資金從電子主線撤出並轉向金融股避險，說明短線市場風險意識明顯抬升。在修正力道明確的背景下，後續宜密切觀察45,000點整數關卡能否發揮實質支撐力道，以及電子權值股何時能止跌回穩。

選擇權未平倉量部分，08月買權最大OI落在48000點，賣權最大OI落在34000點；08月F3買權最大OI落在47500點，賣權最大OI落在39800點。全月份未平倉量put/call ratio值由1.17下降至1.05。VIX指數上升1.38至30.45。外資台指期買權淨金額-1.99億元；賣權淨金額0.39億元。

Intellia Therapeutics（NTLA.US）

2026年第2季，Intellia Therapeutics確認lonvo-z全球第3期HAELO試驗達主要終點，80名患者中第5週至第28週平均每月發作率為0.26，較安慰劑組2.10下降87%。公司並預期2026年底前取得美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）受理生物製劑授權申請（BLA）通知。

CRISPR Therapeutics（CRSP.US）

2026年第2季，CRISPR Therapeutics的CASGEVY銷售額達7600萬美元，季增78%，且FDA已核准擴及2歲以上鐮刀型貧血症或輸血依賴型β地中海型貧血兒童患者。這顯示已上市基因編輯療法正同步推進適應症擴張與市場滲透。

Beam Therapeutics（BEAM.US）

2026年6月，Beam Therapeutics取得BEAM-304的FDA臨床試驗新藥申請（IND）核准，將評估肝臟靶向脂質奈米顆粒（LNP）體內鹼基編輯在R408W突變型苯酮尿症患者的安全性與血中Phe下降。此案把鹼基編輯正式推入臨床監管入口。

Editas Medicine（EDIT.US）

2026年第2季，Editas Medicine公布reni-cel在28名重度鐮刀型貧血成人的RUBY試驗資料，平均胎兒血紅素由2.5%升至48%，且公司表示已檢測樣本未檢出脫靶編輯。這次更新把人體療效幅度與安全性訊號同時推到檯面。

Prime Medicine（PRME.US）

2026年第2季，Prime Medicine確認PM577a已同時取得美國IND clearance與紐西蘭CTA clearance，成為公司首個取得臨床授權的體內先導編輯療法。公司並已建立全球phase 1/2計畫，預期於2027年取得初步臨床數據。

Precision BioSciences（DTIL.US）

2026年第2季，Precision BioSciences公布PBGENE-HBV人體資料，顯示cccDNA衍生轉錄本下降10倍，且治療前可偵測前基因組RNA的6名患者在治療後皆轉為不可偵測。這次更新把基因編輯應用範圍推進到慢性B型肝炎。

Twist Bioscience（TWST.US）

2026會計年度第3季，Twist Bioscience營收達1.184億美元，年增23%，並將全年營收指引上修至4.56億至4.57億美元。同期DNA合成與蛋白解決方案營收年增39%，顯示基因編輯上游設計與合成工具需求仍在擴張。

【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，市場廣度信號顯示台股優於韓股。台股基準指數的反彈看似比韓股更為健康且更具可持續性，推動本輪反彈的動力來自市場廣度的改善，而非集中度的上升。

台灣加權指數中超過半數的成份股價格高於其200日移動均線，而韓股的這一比例僅約為三分之一。

更廣泛的參與表明市場對台股的信心更強，後續漲勢動能也更強勁。相較之下，韓股的反彈主要由一小部分個股推動，這使得Kospi指數相對更易受到衝擊。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》減重藥物—LLY、NVO、AMGN
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-18 15:22:04 數位內容中心 發佈

Eli Lilly（LLY.US）

8月10日，Eli Lilly的口服升糖素樣胜肽-1（GLP-1）藥物Foundayo獲英國藥品與醫療產品管理局（MHRA）核准，用於體重管理與第2型糖尿病，成為該藥美國外首個監管核准、也是歐洲首個核准市場。公司預計8月稍晚先以英國自費私人處方上市。

Novo Nordisk（NVO.US）

8月12日，Novo Nordisk持續把口服Wegovy列為本週主軸，指出該藥自2026年1月在美國上市以來累計處方量已突破500萬張，第2季處方量約290萬張。這使口服劑型成為公司當前減重藥擴量最具體的商業化進展。

Amgen（AMGN.US）

8月11日，Amgen在法說會將MariTide定為肥胖管線核心資產，主打每月給藥，並稱維持劑量有機會降至每年4次或6次。公司目前已有9項進行中與3項規劃中的第III期研究，開發重點已延伸至肥胖相關慢性疾病。

Viking Therapeutics（VKTX.US）

本週，Viking Therapeutics凸顯VK2735的雙劑型開發進度，皮下注射版本兩項第III期試驗已完成收案，口服版本預計於2026年第4季啟動第III期。已披露的第II期數據顯示，皮下注射VK2735在13週平均減重最高達14.7%。

Regeneron（REGN.US）

本週，Regeneron的減重管線olatorepatide因中國第III期試驗數據受到關注，48週平均減重最高達19%。該藥為自中國授權引進的雙重升糖素樣胜肽-1／葡萄糖依賴性胰島素刺激多肽（GLP-1/GIP）致效劑，顯示公司正以外部引進方式補強減重布局。

Kailera Therapeutics（KLRA.US）

本週，Kailera Therapeutics的主軸是ribupatide注射劑已進入慢性體重管理第III期，且同步開發口服劑型。該產品為雙重升糖素樣胜肽-1／葡萄糖依賴性胰島素刺激多肽（GLP-1/GIP）致效劑，顯示公司布局不只押注單一注射版本。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》電子股熄火 指數翻黑收跌548點
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-18 15:14:24 新聞中心 發佈

美股四大指數周一跌多漲少，台股今(18)日早盤一度漲逾200點，站上4萬 6關卡，不過台積電、聯發科、台達電、鴻海等電子權值股走弱，加權指數翻黑，跌幅一路擴大，終場收在45308.68點，下跌548.59點或1.2%，成交量9584.43億元。

受到油價跳漲、美國30年期公債殖利率躍升至19年以來新高衝擊，美國四大指數17日跌多漲少，但記憶體、光通訊類股逆勢走強。亞洲股市方面，因半導體相關股下挫，拖累日經225指數今日開低走低，重挫逾千點，終場下跌2.54%；韓國股市受AI與科技股氣氛帶動強勢反彈，隨後賣壓湧現翻黑，終場下跌1.55%。

台股今日開高走低，終場收在45308.68點，下跌548.59點，市場交投仍維持一定熱度，但指數明顯承受賣壓，顯示短線資金態度偏向審慎。電子族群普遍走弱，台積電早盤翻黑，終場收在2380元，下跌0.83%，聯發科跌逾4%，南電、奇鋐、台達電、鴻勁、緯穎都有超過3%的跌幅，華邦電、日月光投控、鴻海、聯電、廣達等也都跌逾2%。川湖逆勢上揚，並一度衝破15000元大關，最高來到15085元，終場上漲4.51%。

從盤面表現來看，雖然大盤收黑，仍有部分傳產族群逆勢抗跌，其中以航運業表現最強，漲幅達2.09%，成為今日盤面焦點，貨櫃三雄全數走揚，其中萬海漲逾5%，長榮、陽明都漲逾2%。油電燃氣上漲1.01%，受惠防禦性買盤青睞，走勢相對穩健。食品類股上漲0.85%，在資金轉向內需與穩健標的帶動下，也展現撐盤力道。玻璃陶瓷類股今日跌勢最重、達3.49%，其次為電器電纜，下跌2.59%，電腦及週邊設備、綠能環保、其他電子、電子零組件等類股都有超過1%的跌幅。整體而言，今日加權指數受壓回檔，反映市場對後市仍有疑慮，不過資金並未全面退場，而是轉進航運、油電燃氣與食品等族群尋求避風港。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人總計賣超239.3億元；其中，外資及陸資(不含外資自營商)賣超119.85億元，投信買超56.62億元，自營商賣超176.07億元。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》氫能動力—BE、PLUG、APD
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-18 15:07:58 數位內容中心 發佈

Bloom Energy（BE.US）

2026年8月12日，Nebius Group將紐澤西州Vineland的300MWAI資料中心供電方案改採Bloom Energy燃料電池；同日公司並披露與Oracle合作上限擴大至2.8GW，首批1.2GW已簽約並開始部署。這使燃料電池從分散式備援進一步切入資料中心現地供電。

Plug Power（PLUG.US）

2026年8月，Plug Power確認澳洲Hunter Valley Hydrogen Hub已作出最終投資決定（FID），公司將供應50MWGenEco質子交換膜（PEM）電解槽，專案預計年產約4,700噸可再生氫。這是本週少數已進入建設階段、且具明確產量的綠氫專案訊號。

Air Products and Chemicals（APD.US）

Air Products and Chemicals於2026會計年度第3季決定不再推進Louisiana Clean Energy Complex，並同時停止Casa Grande零碳液態氫設施，當季認列最高29億美元稅前費用。這反映大型清潔氫上游專案的資本支出審查明顯轉趨嚴格。

Linde（LIN.US）

Linde在2026年第2季披露sale-of-gas project backlog達81億美元、整體project backlog為110億美元，並在台灣擴建案納入hydrogen production units。這顯示其本週與氫能主題的關聯，集中在長約供氣與持續擴充氫氣基礎設施。

Ballard Power Systems（BLDP.US）

Ballard Power Systems近期簽署最終協議，擬以前期對價2.75億英鎊收購GeoPura；GeoPura已營運超過60台Hydrogen Power Units，產品涵蓋100kW至500kW，系統可堆疊至50MW。這使Ballard的燃料電池應用延伸至固定式氫能發電設備。

news.Title: 美伊緊張＋美債殖利率升，韓股追高後下挫1.55%六個交易日首黑
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美伊60天協議到期後，川普拒絕延長協議並威脅轟炸阿曼，伊朗則揚言由防禦轉向攻勢，市場憂心荷姆茲海峽衝突再度升級；與此同時，美國10年期公債殖利率升至約4.73%，30年期殖利率突破5.31%、創近20年高位。地緣政治與全球借貸成本同步升高，迅速逆轉亞洲市場風險偏好，促使韓股早盤追價買盤退潮並引發獲利了結。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)週二以跳漲2.1%開出，早盤一度大漲3.4%至7,216.62點日高，其後急轉直下，最低下探6,788.78點。終場倒跌108.11點或1.55%，收在6,869.83點，為六個交易日首黑，由日高至日低劇烈震盪427.84點，高低振幅超過6%。

十九大類股中，只有運輸與倉儲類股上漲1.16%，電信類股小升0.05%，其餘全面收黑。醫療與精密設備、營建、運輸設備及機械類股成為主要賣壓中心，跌幅介於3.08%至3.90%。油價上漲加深成本與通膨疑慮，美債殖利率攀升則提高估值折現率，使成長股及利率敏感類股承受雙重壓力。

大型科技股方面，三星電子下跌2.19%，三星SDI重挫5.43%，三星電機大跌7.57%淪為大型股最大魯蛇，「三星科技三傑」同步轉弱，成為KOSPI由紅翻黑的主要拖累；SK海力士則逆勢上漲1.03%。

news.Title: 緊跟台積電！中信金前進亞利桑納州 鳳凰城分行Q4開業
news.Content:
追著台積電跑！中信金控18日召開法說會，總經理高麗雪表示，中國信託銀行海外稅前獲利佔整體銀行獲利比重已超過三成，展現穩健成長動能，為驅動銀行獲利的重要引擎，美國子行的鳳凰城分行預計第4季開業，日本子行（東京之星銀行）熊本分行也已搬遷至熊本車站前，地點更好，希望能夠擴大在當地的業務能量，

中國信託金控2026年上半年合併稅後盈餘達395.37億元，較去年同期成長10％，續創歷年同期新高；累計每股稅後盈餘（EPS）為1.96元，整體股東權益報酬率（ROE）及資產報酬率（ROA）維持穩健，展現良好經營成果與多元獲利動能。

除核心業務穩健成長外，中信金控上半年亦受惠於資本市場表現強勁。由於壽險子公司台灣人壽今年起接軌IFRS 17並配合IFRS 9覆蓋法退場，多數股票部位重分類至透過其他綜合損益按公允價值衡量（FVOCI），在股市上揚帶動下，相關評價利益反映於其他綜合損益（OCI），推升上半年綜合損益達2,515億元，金控淨值突破7,000億元，較去年底成長近60％，資本實力顯著提升。

中信金控主要獲利引擎中國信託商業銀行2026年上半年稅後盈餘達311.78億元，較去年同期成長12％，續創歷年上半年獲利新高，主要受惠於各項核心業務穩健成長。在放款業務方面，國內外新增放款規模已超越去年全年水準，帶動淨利息收益持續提升；財富管理業務則受惠於上半年資本市場交易熱絡，相關手續費收入年增逾四成，表現尤為亮眼。此外，信用卡消費金額穩定成長，以及法人金融業務因放款業務擴增與聯貸相關手續費收入增加，推升整體手續費收入顯著成長。

保險業務方面，子公司台灣人壽2026年上半年稅後盈餘達102.76億元，主要受惠於過往累積合約服務邊際（Contractual Service Margin, CSM）持續攤銷、基金評價利益，以及投資型保單以國際財務報導準則第15號（IFRS 15）重新衡量之影響。台灣人壽優化產品組合，聚焦高CSM的傳統型與保障型商品銷售，提升新契約價值並厚植中長期穩定收益來源。在業務動能方面，受惠於分紅型及投資型保單銷售表現亮眼，累計新契約保費達641億元，較去年同期大幅成長139％，展現強勁業務動能。

news.Title: 台股震盪恐再殺回4萬點？杜金龍曝「箱型操作」心法　獲利了結台積電改押3檔黑馬
news.Content:
台股近來在4萬6000點左右震盪，今（18）日開高走低，早盤一度上揚逾200點，重回4萬6大關後一路殺低。（資料照，中央社）

​台股近來在4萬6000點左右震盪，今（18）日開高走低，早盤一度上揚逾200點，重回4萬6大關後一路殺低，下跌逾500點，最低觸及45316.92點，引發不少投資人的緊張情緒。對此，財經專家 杜金龍 在節目《賺錢放大術》表示，10月前大盤仍可能維持區間震盪，目前市場成交量仍未明顯放大，因此他採取「高出低進」的箱型操作策略，將先前低檔布局台積電的獲利落袋，再轉向基期相對低檔的傳產與金融股。

針對台股近期的走勢，杜金龍表示，台股從高點回落逾8000點，最低跌至39384點，之後受到新台幣升值與外資回補帶動，指數快速反彈，在短短11個交易日內強彈逾6000點。不過，目前市場成交量仍未明顯放大，因此他採取「高出低進」的箱型操作策略。

先將台積電落袋為安　杜金龍改押南亞、台泥、富邦金​

杜金龍認為，如果台股後續拉回並形成「第二隻腳」，反而可能成為中長線投資人的布局機會；即使沒有再度破底，10月前大盤仍可能維持區間震盪。波段高點可能落在明年5月，甚至有機會挑戰53000點，因此，近期震盪不必過度恐慌，反而可視為中長線資金分批布局的時機。

個股方面，杜金龍雖然看好台積電長期基本面，認為明年股價仍有機會挑戰3000元，但短期可能進入區間整理，難以單獨帶動大盤，因此選擇先行獲利了結。他目前更看好低基期的南亞、台泥及富邦金，其中台泥基期低、受到外部因素影響相對有限，具備防禦性；富邦金雖可能面臨資產評價造成的短期損失，但整體營運仍相對穩健。此外，沉寂已久的ABF載板族群，其中南電因台塑集團持股比重高、流通籌碼相對集中，若產業景氣回升，外資與投信重新進場，有機會成為族群中的強勢焦點。

news.Title: 《美股主題週報》關鍵資源「鈾」—CCJ、LEU、DNN
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-08-18 14:49:29 數位內容中心 發佈

Cameco（CCJ.US）

news.Title: AI撐台股底氣！法人看挑戰5萬5　IC設計、記憶體成雙主軸
news.Content:
【記者呂承哲／台北報導】AI需求持續熱絡，帶動台灣出口及經濟強勁成長。台新投信指出，台灣第二季經濟成長率達12.92%，創近40年同期新高，隨全球雲端服務供應商（CSP）擴大資本支出、各國加速建置AI基礎設施，加上國內先進製程、高階封裝產能陸續開出，市場預估台灣2026年全年經濟成長率可達9%至10%，成為台股後市支撐。

台新臺灣IC設計（00947）研究團隊表示，今年以來台股漲幅達50.65%，融資餘額則突破5700億元，增幅達68.05%，高於指數漲幅。若此波修正能有效清洗融資籌碼，將更有利下一波行情。分析師預估，若2027年台股企業獲利成長35%，以21倍本益比估算，下一波高點有機會挑戰5.5萬點。

研究團隊指出，AI需求快速成長，加上技術進步帶動Token使用量攀升，晶片計算成本則持續下滑，有利超大規模資料中心獲利提升，進一步推升台灣AI供應鏈訂單。

其中，IC設計與記憶體受惠規格升級及供不應求，成為主要受惠族群。工研院產科國際所預估，2026年台灣IC產業產值將達8.4兆元、年增29.5%，其中IC設計產值1.7兆元、年增19.7%；記憶體與其他製造產值4612億元，年增達111.9%。台新投信認為，近期台股拉回反而提供布局機會，可留意聚焦IC設計與記憶體題材的台股ETF。

news.Title: 【台股盤後】終場挫548點　科技股回檔、航運股強勢
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年08月18日電）台股今天開高走低，早盤一度重返46000點，隨後遭遇調節賣壓，權值股紛紛走弱，航運類股抗跌，加權指數盤中翻黑，高低震盪超過800點；終場指數收45308.68點，下跌548.59點，跌幅1.2%，成交值新台幣9584.43億元。

電子權值股今天普遍承壓，晶圓代工廠台積電 (2330) 早盤漲至2415元後震盪走跌，終場收在2380元、跌幅0.83%；聯發科 (2454) 失守4000元大關，終場收3885元，跌幅4.07%；鴻海 (2317) 同步走弱，終場收249元，下跌2.35%。

人工智慧（AI）伺服器代工廠廣達 (2382) 、緯創 (3231) 、英業達 (2356) 買盤熄火，終場分別下挫1.95%、3.21%、2.7%。

記憶體族群早盤受報價調漲利多激勵衝高，南亞科 (2408) 、華邦電 (2344) 一度走揚5%，盤中震盪翻黑，終場收在515元、176.5元，下跌1.72%、2.75%。

部分資金轉向傳產族群避險，航運貨櫃三雄長榮 (2603) 、陽明 (2609) 、萬海 (2615) 逆勢抗跌，終場分別上漲2.81%、2.74%、5.42%，收在238元、56.2元、105元；散裝航運業者四維航 (5608) 收漲停15.95元。

千元以上高價股漲跌互見，股后川湖 (2059) 盤中衝上15085元續寫新天價，終場上揚4.51%，收14370元；股王信驊 (5274) 小漲0.21%，收17055元。

統一投顧董事長(黎)方國對中央社記者表示，台股今天衝破46000點後急殺翻黑，主因企業半年報公布後利多出盡與籌碼面解套賣壓；且台股7月大跌後，8月自底部強彈達7000點，短線波段漲幅已滿足，壓抑大盤往上攻堅的動能。

(黎)方國指出，美國與伊朗備忘錄到期增添地緣政治與油價變數，加上美國聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）本週將公布會議紀要，釋出利率路徑方向，讓市場對貨幣政策與通膨走向轉趨觀望，限制短線資金追價意願。

展望後市，(黎)方國認為，全球股市與台股均進入箱型區間震盪格局，下週市場將迎來兩大重頭戲，包括8月26日輝達（NVIDIA）公布財報，以及8月27日至29日的全球央行年會（Jackson Hole）；在相關訊息出爐前，預估台股短線將在上波反彈高點約46402點至月線約44010點的區間內橫盤整理。

news.Title: 台股衝破46,000關卡後翻黑 專家揭「越跌越快」真相
news.Content:
[Newtalk新聞] 台股今(18日)呈現開高走低格局，早盤開盤報45,922.40點，最高衝至46,064.09點後隨即面臨龐大拋售壓力，盤中賣壓逐步擴大並大幅下殺，最低觸及45,225.42點。終場大盤重挫 548.59 點（或 1.20%），收在 45,308.68 點，成交金額爆出約 9,584.43 億元大量。

今日盤面除集中在大盤震盪與個別強勢股表現之外，明（19）日即將登場的台指期結算成為引發短線波動的核心因素。

期貨結算壓盤 當沖賣單加速跌勢

針對今日大盤急挫，分析師郭哲榮表示，近期盤勢震盪投資人不必過度緊張，今日開高走低主要與台指期即將進行結算密切相關。在結算前夕，市場短線交易情緒容易被放大，當盤面跌勢形成後，當沖與短線賣單隨即追價賣出，進一步加速賣壓釋放，才使盤面呈現「越跌越快」的急跌現象。

郭哲榮進一步說明，期貨結算前一至兩個交易日，個股極易受到籌碼面調整與短線資金進出影響，出現突發性急跌。

news.Title: 電子權值股拉回，台股測試季線，台塑、航運及金融相對強勢
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美伊談判可能沒有結果，中東和平希望又要拖延，國際油價再度上揚；另一方面美國30年期公債殖利率又竄升，使得亞洲股市普遍拉回，台股又面臨台幣升值，電子下游代工股下跌，半導體股普遍拉回，記憶體股開高走低，高價強勢股亦同，股王及股后力撐場面上漲，其他各如ABF、CPO、AI供應鏈等族群漲跌互見，功率半導體族群較強。下跌家數超過三分之二，只靠台塑四寶、航運股拉升，金融股約持平，指數終場下跌548.59點，收在45308.68點，成交量9584.43億元。短線面臨日KD值交叉向下，操作宜較保守。在美國與伊朗談判時間拉長，川普似乎失去耐心，表示60天談判時間不會再拉長，國際油價再度竄升，北海布蘭特原油突破90美元，地緣政治緊張局勢瞬間升溫。另一方面美國30年期公債殖利率創19年新高達5.31%，高殖利率對風險資產（尤其是科技股）造成嚴重的估值壓抑，導致美股主要指數多數收跌；由於距離美國期中選舉11月5日逼近，過去選前通常以盤整或是下跌居多，導致追價者降低。

費半指數週一除設備、記憶體股上漲外，大都拉回，其他三大指數收黑。短線上需注意指數月線是重要防守線，一旦不守可能要整理一陣子。而費半指數也必須站穩季線之上才可，否則也可能進入整理。

日本股市正陷入日圓升值能否成功？下一步可能是再拉高利率，股市下跌超過千點。韓國股市開高走低，三星下跌、海力士上漲，必未隨美國記憶體一起大漲，有點偏弱勢。

台股台積電(2330)始終未再上層樓，而下游代工股鴻海(2317)、廣達(2382)、緯創(3231)、英業達(2356)、仁寶(2324)全面拉回。矽智財的聯發科(2454)、創意(3443)、世芯(3661)也拉回。聯電(2303)、力積電(6770)、世界先進(5347)亦同，權值股幾乎跌多漲少。高價股川湖(2059)、信驊(5274)、大立光(3008)上漲，其他大都拉回。最強勢的ABF及CCL族群只有欣興(3037)及聯茂(6213)上漲，其他都下跌。矽光子族群只有聯鈞(3450)、聯亞(3081)、IET(4971)上漲。AI供應鏈勤誠(8210)、金像電(2368)、富世達(6805)、光寶科(2301)、貿聯(3665)翻紅。功率半導體從上游的茂矽(2342)、中美晶(5483)、環球晶圓(6488)到大中(6435)、台半(5425)表現較強且整齊。設備股有由田(3455)、大量(3167)表現較好。

傳產股以台塑四寶表現較佳，航運股則有貨櫃的長榮(2603)、陽明(2609)、萬海(2615)表現最強。金融股週一拉回在前，週二普遍止穩，是支撐大盤重心。

短線上指數似乎有測試季線可能，須注意匯市及美日韓股市走勢。

news.Title: 震盪盤怎佈局？「PCB女王」點名5檔AI寶藏股：拉回就買
news.Content: 台股近期持續在4.6萬點附近震盪，市場觀望氣氛濃厚，投資人也關注指數失守關卡究竟是回檔風險，還是布局良機。對此，「PCB女王」、統一投顧總經理廖婉婷認為，目前台股利空大致已經消化，短期暫未見新的重大利空，若股價拉回反而可留意布局機會，並點名台光電（2383）、創意（3443）、聯發科（2454）、欣興（3037）、光寶科（2301）5檔個股，看好其財報表現及明年獲利成長。 廖婉婷日前在理財節目 《兆華艾綸說》 表示，現階段AI算力需求仍主要集中在雲端，隨著未來機器人、車用及邊緣AI（Edge AI）應用逐步擴大，算力需求可能進一步爆發，供給缺口也有望持續存在。不過，對於具有漲價題材的族群，她提醒，若市場觀察到報價已接近漲不動，投資人就不宜再追高，預期相關族群下半年漲勢可能逐漸趨緩。 廖婉婷看好「這5檔」個股 台光電（2383）：她認為第2季毛利率表現亮眼，加上7月營收月增約10%，公司積極布局PTFE及載板新材料，PCB規格升級有望成為後續成長動能。 創意（3443）：受惠ASIC架構CPU訂單，以及取得台積電先進製程產能優勢，第3季營運展望優於預期，明年還可望受惠Google新一代CPU、TPU產品放量。若以明年EPS上看150元估算，目前本益比仍有吸引力。 聯發科（2454）：雖面臨消費性電子需求調整，但AI、車用、傳輸及Google下一代TPU訂單動能明確，明年獲利仍有大幅成長空間。 欣興（3037）：受惠封裝技術升級，ABF載板需求及價格下半年至明年可望續強，被視為載板族群重要成長指標。 光寶科（2301）：第2季毛利率表現突出，第3季起受惠高階伺服器電源新品出貨，明年進一步布局800V HVDC架構，長期成長動能受到看好。 廖婉婷認為，AI產業下一階段不只看雲端，更要觀察機器人、車用等Edge AI應用擴張。對投資人而言，與其追逐短線漲價題材，不如鎖定財報優於預期、具明年成長能見度的個股，等待市場震盪拉回時尋找布局機會。 ▼廖婉婷看好「這5檔」個股。（圖／翻攝《兆華艾綸說》粉專）

news.Title: 台股要殺回4萬點？專家先賣台積電 改押「3大黑馬」
news.Content:
台股近期在4萬6千點附近反覆震盪，連續三天挑戰站穩未果，今（18）日開高走低，最低下探45316.92點。台股歷經高檔大幅修正後強勢反彈，市場原本對行情重返高點抱持樂觀態度，但資深分析師杜金龍卻選擇在指數高檔大幅降低持股，將持股水位從九成降至五成，並把先前低檔布局台積電的獲利落袋，再轉向基期相對低檔的傳產與金融股。

杜金龍在財經節目《賺錢放大術》中表示，台股從高點回落逾8000點，最低跌至39384點，之後受到新台幣升值與外資回補帶動，指數快速反彈，在短短11個交易日內強彈逾6000點。不過，目前市場成交量仍未明顯放大，因此他採取「高出低進」的箱型操作策略。

杜金龍認為，如果台股後續拉回並形成「第二隻腳」，反而可能成為中長線投資人的布局機會；即使沒有再度破底，10月前大盤仍可能維持區間震盪。波段高點可能落在明年5月，甚至有機會挑戰53000點，因此，近期震盪不必過度恐慌，反而可視為中長線資金分批布局的時機。

個股方面，杜金龍雖然看好台積電長期基本面，認為明年股價仍有機會挑戰3000元，但短期可能進入區間整理，難以單獨帶動大盤，因此選擇先行獲利了結。他目前更看好低基期的南亞、台泥及富邦金，其中台泥基期低、受到外部因素影響相對有限，具備防禦性；富邦金雖可能面臨資產評價造成的短期損失，但整體營運仍相對穩健。

此外，杜金龍也看好沉寂已久的ABF載板族群，其中南電因台塑集團持股比重高、流通籌碼相對集中，若產業景氣回升，外資與投信重新進場，有機會成為族群中的強勢焦點。

news.Title: 股票淪壁紙差一步！面板廠無預警停牌原因曝 網炸鍋：正港「奪魂巨」
news.Content:
面板大廠凌巨科技(8105)第2季財報難產，昨（17）日晚間重訊指出近期因股權與經營權異動，董事會成員僅剩1名，無法依法召開董事會通過第2季財報，證交所並公告，依規自明（19）日起停止買賣，若未在限期內補正，最重將面臨終止上市處分，衝擊逾4萬名股東權益，網友討論熱烈，紛紛表示：「正港奪魂巨」、「電子壁紙」。

身為唯一第2季財報「繳白卷」的上市櫃公司，凌巨昨日股價跌停收15.1元，成交量2453張，盤後還有9285張賣單排隊，賣壓相當沉重。

公司方面表示，本次無法如期申報財報原因是董事會組成結構異動，雖已於7月17日向證期局申請展延申報期限，但主管機關7月31日正式回函拒絕，認定董事缺額並不屬於「不可抗力因素」，因此未獲核准。

24日股臨會改選董事

但強調目前日常營運、財務及各項業務均正常進行，與客戶、供應商及金融機構往來皆未受影響，並無任何營運或財務中斷情形。

因應董事會運作停擺，導致股票停牌，凌巨預計在下周一（24日）召開股臨會改選董事，強調新董事會組成後，將立即召開臨時董事會，盡速完成第2季財報的申報作業，以符合公司治理標準，並維護股東權益。

網譏巨字輩再添猛將

PTT網友對此討論熱烈，有網友表示「完蛋 要好幾根」、「至少半價吧」、「電子壁紙」等，還有人對凌巨公司治理現況充滿疑問，「現任董事僅剩1人，是都逃跑了嗎？」、「這樣重要決策要怎麼決議阿 神奇」、「早就人去樓空，人走茶涼，剩洗碗仔洗到破皮吧」。

還有網友發揮幽默本性，繼被動元件龍頭國巨*(2327)股價腰斬而被戲封為「奪魂巨」，表示「巨字輩再添一員猛將」、「有巨的是不是都很慘」、「名字帶巨的要小心」、「巨人一族」，或是說「這才是真正的奪魂巨，跑都跑不掉XD」。

news.Title: Insider Sale: Monolithic Power Systems Interim CFO Sells 105 Shares for $141,148
news.Content:
Robert W. Dean, Interim CFO of Monolithic Power Systems (NASDAQ:MPWR), executed a sale of 105 shares of common stock on Aug. 5, 2026, according to a recent SEC Form 4 filing .

Transaction summary

Transaction value based on SEC Form 4 weighted average sale price ($1,344.27); post-transaction value based on Aug. 5, 2026, market close ($1,345.46).

Key questions

What is the core business profile of Monolithic Power Systems?

Monolithic Power Systems specializes in the creation, promotion, and sale of advanced semiconductor components for power management. Its core offerings consist of direct-current-to-direct-current integrated circuits, which are vital for regulating electrical voltages in sectors including information technology, automotive, telecommunications, and consumer electronics.

What is the relative scale of this sale in the context of the company's valuation?

The $141,148 transaction is minor relative to the company's current $68.9 billion market capitalization. After this sale, total insider ownership across the firm stands at 0.0146%.

How is the insider's remaining equity structured?

The majority of the insider's position is held directly, totaling 7,132 shares. The remaining 65 shares are held indirectly through an entity identified as Parent & Daughter, as noted in the beneficial ownership disclosures.

How does the current valuation compare to the transaction price?

The 105 shares were sold at $1,344.27 per share, slightly below the transaction-date market close of $1,345.46. This execution occurred against a backdrop of a $3.3 billion trailing-twelve-month revenue stream and $801.9 million in net income.

Company Overview

Market Capitalization

Company Snapshot

Monolithic Power Systems designs, develops, and markets advanced semiconductor power management solutions, including direct current (DC) to-DC integrated circuits (ICs), which serve as core revenue drivers across multiple end markets.

The company generates revenue through the licensing, development, and sale of proprietary semiconductor intellectual property and integrated circuit products that enable efficient power conversion and voltage regulation across diverse applications.

Primary customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and system integrators in information technology, data storage, automotive, industrial, telecommunications, and consumer electronics sectors.

Story Continues

Monolithic Power Systems is a leading semiconductor power management company with a market capitalization of $68.9 billion and TTM revenue of $3.3 billion, demonstrating significant scale and profitability with TTM net income of $801.9 million. The company's competitive advantage derives from its specialized expertise in power management integrated circuits and its ability to serve mission-critical applications across high-growth end markets, including cloud computing infrastructure, automotive electrification, and industrial automation. With a one-year stock price appreciation of 64.8%, MPWR reflects strong market recognition of its technological differentiation and financial performance.

What this transaction means for investors

Monolithic Power targets the automotive, cloud computing , consumer electronics, and industrial markets. Serving the semiconductor power market, in particular, is a boon for the company. The stock price is up 64.8% over the last year and has done even better over the past five years, climbing nearly 195%. For its 2026 second-quarter earnings, Monolothic reported record quarterly revenue of $980.6 million, which was 21.9% higher than the first quarter of 2026. It was also 47.6% higher than the prior-year period. The company saw a 44.8% sequential increase in its Enterprise Data segment, which reported sales of $380.6 million. Its Enterprise Data segment also accounted for 38.8% of total revenue in the second quarter of 2026. It also saw 18% sequential revenue growth in its Communication division and 12.7% sequential growth in its Industrial segment. It saw slower growth in its Automotive segment, which climbed just 3.1% seqentially to $157.1 million.

With the strong performance of the stock price over the last year and the company reaching record revenue in the second quarter of 2026, Dean's sale appears largely routine. He only sold 105 shares while retaining over 7,000 shares. This most likely seems like a sale to take advantage of a rising stock price rather than one driven by concern about the company.

news.Title: Wall Street Thinks Monolithic Power Is a Buy. Here’s Why It Might Be Right.
news.Content:
Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) just picked up another vote of confidence. GF Securities recently initiated coverage of the stock with a "Buy" rating and a $1,706 price target, which is well above where the shares trade today. The reason comes down to one shift that keeps getting bigger. AI chips need power, and Monolithic makes the parts that deliver it. Basically, every new generation of AI chip, from Nvidia's (NVDA) older models to its upcoming ones, draws far more electricity than the last. That power has to be delivered cleanly and precisely, right next to the chip, or performance suffers. Monolithic designs those power components. In other words, as AI chips get hungrier, each one needs more of Monolithic's parts, at a higher value per chip. The company essentially sells more with every step up in AI computing power.

The Numbers Are Already Showing It

This isn't just a forecast, since it's already showing up in the results. Monolithic reported record revenue of $981 million last quarter, up 48% from a year earlier. The standout was its enterprise data business, the segment tied to AI and data center chips, which jumped 45% sequentially. Demand was strong enough that management raised its full-year growth target for that segment from 85% to a staggering 130%.

More News from Barchart

Stop Missing Market Moves: Get the FREE Barchart Brief – your midday dose of stock movers, trending sectors, and actionable trade ideas, delivered right to your inbox. Sign Up Now!

The company is also spreading its bets. Beyond AI, it's winning new business in the automotive sector, communications equipment, and pushing into robotics. On the earnings call, CEO Michael Hsing described the shift that the company is going through. He said Monolithic is moving from just selling chips to providing complete power solutions and called it "the highest power density company in the world."

GF Securities isn't alone in its optimism. A vast majority of Wall Street analysts covering Monolithic rate it a "Buy." To give you an idea of how bullish the analysts are, even the lowest price target of $1,575 is higher than Monolithic's current stock price. The consensus among these experts is broadly the same. As long as AI keeps demanding more power, the company making the parts that deliver it should keep growing rapidly.

About MPWR Stock

Monolithic Power Systems is a semiconductor company that designs power management chips used in a wide range of electronic devices. Its products help control and convert electrical power in technologies such as AI servers, data centers, computers, automotive systems, communication networks, consumer electronics, and industrial equipment. The company sells its solutions to customers worldwide. Founded in 1997, the company is headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida.

Story Continues

Over the past year, MPWR stock has gained approximately 63%, although it has underperformed the iShares Semiconductor ETF's (SOXX) gain of 115% during the same period. Earlier this year, the stock traded around $1,002 in late March before surging to $1,632 on April 24 following the company's strong first-quarter earnings report. The biggest driver of the rally was the Enterprise Data Segment. It grew nearly 98% year-over-year (YoY), driven by higher sales of power-management solutions for AI and server applications. After trading sideways for several months, the stock began to decline in mid-June and continued to move lower in the following weeks.

Monolithic's valuation looks reasonable given the pace of its growth. The forward GAAP price-to-earnings (P/E) of 63.16x sits marginally below its 5-year average of 66.95x. In contrast, the forward price-to-sales (P/S) ratio of 17.01x sits at a 14% premium to its 5-year average of 14.93x. So the market is paying up in terms of sales but is getting a discount relative to its own history on earnings, which fits a company growing profits this quickly. The EPS outlook for the decade looks promising. Analysts expect growth of 54% in 2026, 27% in 2027, 16% in 2028, and then picking the pace again to 30% in 2029. For a company already worth over $70 billion, that is a solid growth trajectory.

The capital structure is another aspect working for the firm. Monolithic holds $1.41 billion in cash against just $18.93 million in debt, leaving it essentially debt-free. That gives it plenty of room to keep funding its shift toward complete power solutions without borrowing. For investors, this is an attractive valuation. The premium on sales looks modest given how fast earnings are climbing, and the strong balance sheet limits the downside.

Enterprise Data Emerges as Key Growth Engine for MPS

Monolithic Power Systems reported its second-quarter 2026 earnings on July 30. It reported stronger-than-expected quarterly results with revenue of $980.6 million, up 48% YoY. The earnings per share came in at $6.50, comfortably beating the Wall Street consensus of $5.85. Enterprise data grew 45% sequentially while communications grew 80%, faster than the roughly 50% pace in the prior quarter. Management said channel inventory remained very low and book-to-bill is well above 1.0x, pointing to continued demand visibility.

Looking forward, management said all segments are expected to grow sequentially in the third quarter. Enterprise data and communications are expected to remain the strongest areas. Consumer is likely to stay weak, while industrial should grow slightly with the broader market. MPS raised its full-year 2026 growth target for the enterprise data segment to 130% from 85%. Customer ramps, new socket wins, higher module content, and CPU-related demand are the drivers that support this growth. In addition, the company also pointed to several long-term initiatives. These include initial orders for high-speed DDR5 memory interface controllers, continued growth in 48-volt vertical power modules, and progress in building automation. Gross margin is expected to remain similar or slightly higher in the third quarter, while operating margin should continue to expand as revenue rises.

What Do Analysts Expect for MPWR Stock?

Analysts updated their financial model following the first-quarter earnings report and came out positive on MPWR stock. Citi analyst Kelsey Chia reiterated a "Buy" rating on MPWR and set a price target of $1,820. The analyst's price target reflects 32% upside from current levels. In addition, Wells Fargo also maintained a "Buy" rating with a price target of $1,800.

Based on 14 Wall Street analysts with coverage, MPWR stock holds a consensus "Strong Buy" rating. Out of those, 11 have a "Strong Buy" rating, two have a "Moderate Buy" rating, and one has a "Hold" rating. The mean price target of $1,830.83 reflects an additional 33% upside from current levels, while the high price target of $2,100 implies 52% upside from the current share price. The positive sentiment is due to accelerating AI-driven demand and expectations that the company will continue gaining share in the rapidly growing artificial intelligence infrastructure market.

news.Title: Analysts Are Upping Their Price Targets on Lumentum Stock. Here's Why.
news.Content:
Once known mainly for supplying telecom and fiber-optic components, Lumentum Holdings (LITE) has moved closer to the heart of the artificial intelligence (AI) buildout, where data centers increasingly demand faster, higher-bandwidth connections. The strategic shift is becoming visible in its financial results.

The company delivered Q4 FY2026 results, with revenue and earnings beating Wall Street expectations and extending its streak to eight consecutive quarters of revenue growth. Sales increased by triple digits year-over-year (YOY), powered by demand for optical components used in AI data centers, reinforcing its AI-driven growth narrative.

Analysts have responded with a series of rating and target adjustments. For instance, TD Cowen raised its Lumentum price target to $820 from $800 while maintaining a "Hold" rating. Analyst Sean O'Loughlin pointed to continued strong execution, although he also acknowledged lingering questions about the broader business cycle.

TD Cowen said management's commentary on demand remained consistent with previous quarters and intra-quarter messaging, suggesting little deterioration in the environment. The firm believes investor models were already ahead of Street estimates, yet it still raised its financial forecasts and introduced a fiscal 2028 EPS estimate above $30.

As Lumentum's growth gains momentum and analysts continue to revise their expectations, let's take a closer look at the stock.

About Lumentum Stock

The San Jose, California-based Lumentum manufactures optical and photonic technologies for cloud, networking, and industrial applications. With a market cap of roughly $72.6 billion, its products serve data centers, AI infrastructure, telecommunications, semiconductor manufacturing, solar cells, displays, electric vehicles (EVs), batteries and technology markets.

The stock's performance has been anything but sleepy. Lumentum's shares have skyrocketed 661% over the last 52 weeks, while gaining 148.2% year-to-date (YTD). Momentum has remained lively recently, too, with shares advancing 19.1% over the past month.

Story Continues

The price performance run has pushed valuation well beyond historical norms. LITE stock is trading at 43.12 times forward adjusted price-to-earnings and 13.19 times sales. Both figures sit above industry averages and their own five-year average multiples, suggesting investors are paying a premium for Lumentum's prospects.

Lumentum Surpasses Q4 Earnings

On August 11, Lumentum reported its Q4 FY2026 earnings results, and the stock responded with a 13.6% gain in the following trading session. Total revenue grew 109.3% YOY to $1 billion, landing at the high end of management's guidance range overall while also beating Street forecasts of $988.6 million.

Non-GAAP gross margin reached 50.4%, up 1,260 basis points YOY, helped by better manufacturing utilization, favorable product mix, and increased pricing on select products. Meanwhile, non-GAAP operating margin came in at 36.6%, up 2,160 basis points YOY.

At the same time, Lumentum is investing in R&D programs serving cloud and AI customers while maintaining rigorous cost controls to optimize its business model. Q4 non-GAAP operating profit reached $368.8 million, while Adjusted EBITDA came in at $406.4 million.

Non-GAAP net income rose 415.5% from the year-ago value to $326.3 million, while non-GAAP EPS rose 267% YOY to $3.23. The result exceeded management's prior expected range and topped Wall Street expectations of $2.99.

The company also spent $167 million in CapEx during the quarter, which was directed toward manufacturing capacity supporting cloud and AI customers, underscoring where Lumentum sees demand coming from.

Looking ahead, management anticipates Q1 FY2027 net revenue between $1.225 billion and $1.275 billion, with the $1.25 billion midpoint representing more than 130% YOY growth. The midpoint would also establish another all-time quarterly revenue record for Lumentum.

They also project Q1 non-GAAP operating margin to range from 39.5%-40.5%, while non-GAAP diluted net income per share is estimated at $4.05-$4.35. At the midpoint, that operating margin represents an expansion of more than 2,100 basis points YOY.

On the other hand, analysts expect Q1 FY2027 EPS to rise 435% YOY to $3.21, while full-year FY2027 EPS is forecasted to grow 105% YOY to $16.67, before rising another 58.4% to $26.40 in FY2028.

What Do Analysts Expect for Lumentum Stock?

Beyond TD Cowen, other analysts have also taken a bullish stance on Lumentum following its latest earnings report. Wolfe Research analyst George Notter maintained a "Buy" rating on LITE stock with a $1,200 price target.

Also, J.P. Morgan's Joseph Cardoso reiterated a "Buy" rating and raised his target from $1,165 to $1,280. The two calls add to the growing optimism surrounding Lumentum's earnings trajectory and position in the AI infrastructure boom.

More broadly, analysts remain bullish, giving Lumentum a "Strong Buy" rating. Among 22 analysts covering the stock, 15 recommend a "Strong Buy," two assign a "Moderate Buy," and five suggest investors "Hold."

To that end, the average price target stands at $1,111.41, implying potential upside of 21.5%. Meanwhile, the Street-High target sits at $1,400 and points to a possible gain of 53% from current levels.

news.Title: onsemi Boosts Utilization as AI Data Center Revenue Set to More Than Double
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in onsemi? Here are five stocks we like better.

AI data center revenue is expected to more than double to over $500 million this year from approximately $250 million last year, with growth spanning high-, medium- and low-voltage power applications.

onsemi increased factory utilization to 83% from 68%, and management expects further utilization gains to drive gross-margin improvement without requiring a new capital-expenditure cycle.

Automotive restocking remains uneven, while the company continues defending its planned Synaptics acquisition, which it expects to generate $200 million in synergies and become accretive within 18 months.

3 Robotics Stocks Under $10: Value, Momentum, or Bet?

onsemi (NASDAQ:ON) executives said the company is increasing factory utilization to meet stronger demand in AI data center markets while maintaining its longer-term focus on automotive and industrial customers.

Speaking at a KeyBanc Capital Markets event, President and CEO Hassane El-Khoury said the company's decision to prioritize certain data center demand was a temporary operating adjustment rather than a strategic shift away from automotive and industrial markets. While finished products cannot be redirected once packaged for specific applications, he said manufacturing capacity remains flexible through most of the production process.

→ Applied Materials Beat Everything but Wall Street's Expectations for Margins

MarketBeat Week in Review – 08/03 - 08/07

"From a fab perspective, not just from a fab, all the way to technology, it is fungible," El-Khoury said. He cited 1,200-volt silicon carbide products that can be used in automotive 800-volt systems or AI data center applications. The company can make allocation decisions until products are roughly two weeks from completion, he said, compared with lead times of more than 30 weeks for new production.

Utilization Seen Supporting Margins

El-Khoury said onsemi has capacity available and does not need a new capital-expenditure cycle to address current demand. The company raised utilization to 83%, while full utilization is generally in the 92% to 93% range, he said. Capital spending remains planned at a mid-single-digit percentage level.

→ Texas Roadhouse and Brinker International Have the Recipe Rivals Are Missing

The AI Chip Stock Making a Quiet Move Toward Dominance

Chief Financial Officer Thad Trent said utilization is expected to be the primary driver of gross-margin improvement over the next six to 12 months. The company exited the prior year with utilization at 68% before increasing it to 83% last quarter.

Story Continues

According to Trent, each percentage point of utilization improvement contributes roughly 25 to 30 basis points of gross-margin improvement two quarters later. He said onsemi saw margins improve in the second quarter and guided for a significant step-up in the third quarter, with further improvement expected in the fourth quarter and into the following year.

→ AirJoule Technologies: Short Squeeze Setup Amid Rising Risks

Trent also cited several longer-term margin factors:

Lower underutilization charges as factory utilization rises toward 92% to 93%.

About 200 basis points of improvement from the company's FabRight initiatives.

Benefits from manufacturing-site divestitures, some beginning in 2027 and more substantially in 2028.

Potentially favorable product mix and the end of bridge-inventory consumption from prior fab divestitures.

He said the company recorded 650 basis points of underutilization charges in the second quarter. Price increases initiated April 1 and a second round now underway should also provide a near-term tailwind, though the full effect will take several quarters to reach the profit-and-loss statement.

Automotive Inventory Remains Uneven

El-Khoury said automotive restocking has not been consistent, and the company has yet to see a broad replenishment cycle among customers. Industry vehicle-production rates have been flat to slightly down, he said, while inventory has been drawn down across parts of the supply chain.

He said some automotive original equipment manufacturers are becoming more directly involved in purchasing components from onsemi, rather than relying entirely on Tier 1 suppliers to build inventory. Under that arrangement, onsemi ships to the OEM, which then determines which Tier 1 supplier receives the components.

The direct-purchasing model is not yet broad among traditional OEMs, El-Khoury said. However, he described it as already common among Chinese OEMs and North American electric-vehicle companies. He said the model could become more important if automotive demand rises while supply remains constrained by competition for shared power-semiconductor capacity.

AI Data Center Revenue Expected to More Than Double

El-Khoury said onsemi's AI data center power revenue, defined as revenue generated within AI data centers, is expected to rise from about $250 million last year to more than $500 million this year. Growth is occurring across the data center power tree, rather than in a single component category, he said.

The company historically approached the market from high-voltage power applications, but has gained share across high-, medium- and low-voltage areas, according to El-Khoury. He said onsemi is seeking broad exposure across customers, platforms and geographies, including power-system providers and end customers such as AWS and NVIDIA.

El-Khoury said the company estimates its data center serviceable available market per rack could increase from $15,000 currently to $115,000 by 2030. Of the current figure, he said about 30% is high-voltage content. At the projected 2030 level, high-voltage and medium-/low-voltage content would each account for roughly half, with high-voltage content rising to approximately $55,000 per rack.

He also said onsemi has sampled its high-voltage vertical gallium nitride technology for AI data center and automotive applications. The product is a monolithic 1,200-volt device, and qualification processes are progressing as expected, he said.

Executives Defend Synaptics Transaction

El-Khoury said investor understanding of onsemi's planned Synaptics acquisition has improved since the announcement, as investors have become more familiar with Synaptics' transformation over the past five years. He said the acquisition is intended to add an AI-first compute franchise without reducing onsemi's investment in its core power business.

Trent said the transaction is expected to be accretive to onsemi's gross-margin target and cash-flow positive. He said onsemi expects to use its scale, distribution network and customer base to broaden deployment of Synaptics products.

El-Khoury reiterated that the company expects $200 million in synergies to make the deal accretive within 18 months, while noting that additional manufacturing, distribution and revenue synergies could emerge beyond that period. He said a high percentage of Synaptics' non-Astra products could be candidates for internal manufacturing, subject to integration, cost and capital-spending considerations.

About onsemi (NASDAQ:ON)

onsemi is engaged in disruptive innovations and also a supplier of power and analog semiconductors. The firm offers vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure, with a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets. It operates through the following segments: Power Solutions Group, Advanced Solutions Group, and Intelligent Sensing Group. The Power Solutions Group segment offers discrete, module, and semiconductor products that perform multiple application functions, including power switching, power conversion, signal conditioning, circuit protection, signal amplification, and voltage reference functions.
